Time: early evening, just after sunset — the sky still holds soft light, the scene is clearly visible, NOT dark, NOT night. Gentle dusk ambience.

Setting: an open-air gallery corridor on an upper floor of a residential block — a long balcony walkway with a row of apartment front doors. High above the street, many floors up.

Composition: deep one-point perspective down the long corridor. The walkway is moderately narrow: from the doors to the balcony edge is about THREE PACES. The corridor is LONG, and at its far end it visibly TURNS RIGHT around the corner of the building — no staircase anywhere, no steps, no dead-end wall, just the walkway bending right and continuing out of sight.

Right side: a row of EIGHT metal front doors along the corridor, with STRICTLY UNIFORM spacing — the rhythm repeats evenly: door — five to six paces of wall with a window — next door, the same interval every time, all the way down. The doors are authentic Hong Kong apartment gate doors, exactly like the attached references: painted metal grille gates with vertical bars — one pale blue-grey with a solid middle panel, one ornate beige with decorative leaf-pattern metalwork, others in worn green, dark grey steel, faded cream — each with real handles and locks, red good-luck banners (fai chun) pasted on and around the door frames, small unit number plates, stickers, a pair of slippers or shoes on the doormat by some thresholds. Every door photorealistic, aged, believable — real Hong Kong texture. In each wall section between doors: a full-size household window with real frames, some with curtains behind the glass, some with metal grilles, a few glowing faintly from inside. Doors never stand side by side; two or three doors in the near half of the frame, the rest receding evenly with perspective.

Left side: the balcony edge is an open METAL RAILING — a waist-high balustrade of thin vertical metal bars with a rounded handrail on top, old painted metal, worn and slightly chipped, see-through. Laundry dries on the railing: large bath towels draped over the handrail at several spots along the walkway, socks and small clothes pinned to short lines strung low along the balustrade — everyday lived-in laundry, nothing hanging from the ceiling. Beyond the railing — the evening city: high-rise towers of different heights in the distance, scattered warm lit windows, soft haze. In the courtyard below, a tall tree grows up toward the building, its leafy crown just reaching the level of this floor at the railing.

Lighting: warm YELLOW is the dominant light — old tungsten lamps under the ceiling glow amber-yellow, casting warm pools along the walkway and on the doors. Outside, beyond the railing, the ambience carries a light, soft green tint — gentle, muted, filmic, NOT acid, NOT neon, NOT oversaturated.

Grade: warm yellow lamplight inside the corridor balanced against the soft green-tinted evening outside — restrained  palette, fine 35mm film grain, natural textures: worn concrete floor, aged plaster, exposed pipes along the ceiling. Empty corridor, no people. Eye-level wide shot, strong vanishing point, the walkway receding and turning right in the distance, photorealistic film still.

LAMPS — important: a row of ceiling lamps runs along the ENTIRE corridor — old round tungsten fixtures mounted under the ceiling slab, one after another receding into the distance, ALL SWITCHED ON, glowing warm amber-yellow, casting repeating pools of warm light on the floor, the doors and the walls, clearly the main light source of the scene. The receding line of glowing lamps emphasizes the perspective.

Right side: a row of METAL front doors — each one different: grey steel, green-painted iron, dark metal gate, faded blue-grey, with real handles, locks and scratches. Between one door and the next: FIVE TO SIX PACES of wall with a proper full-size household window set into it — real frames, some with curtains, some with metal grilles, a few glowing faintly from inside. Doors never side by side; two or three doors in the near half of the frame, the rest receding.

Left side: the balcony edge is an open METAL RAILING — waist-high balustrade of thin vertical bars with a rounded handrail, old worn paint. LAUNDRY dries ON THE RAILING ONLY: large bath towels draped over the handrail, socks and small clothes pinned to short lines strung low along the balustrade between its posts. NOTHING hangs from the ceiling — no clothes on the ceiling, no hangers overhead, the space above the walkway is completely clear. Beyond the railing — the evening city: high-rise towers with many warm lit windows, soft haze; in the courtyard below a tall tree

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

场景背景
香港九十年代中期深夜，六十年代唐楼的单间公寓入口区。她下班回家做完例行动作，闻到屋里有一股别人的气味——还没紧张，只是起疑，然后转身往厨房走。全片只有她一人；惊悚感来自静止画面、绿光和声音

第3步：她上半身转回身后，右手扶门扇右缘把门由左向右推回合上。青绿被门板逐渐挡死，屋里只剩台灯暖光和竹帘缝那道淡绿

脱鞋规则——逐步编排（硬性，两只靴子一前一后，绝不同时）

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

全片每个光源从第一帧到最后一帧一直亮着，亮度色温完全恒定。绝对禁止：灯自行点亮或熄灭、忽明忽暗、闪烁、跳变。走廊灯和屋里红罩台灯二十秒都开着不变

绿光可落在地砖、墙面、门板和她的肩背轮廓上，但绝不正面照她的脸

0.0-1.2秒——门扇由右向左向内划开，浓青绿随角度逐渐涌进，在陶砖上铺开
1.2-2.4秒——她跨门槛朝摄影机走进屋里，站到画面中央偏右的地垫，逆光深色身影只占高门洞下半部
2.4-3.5秒——她把门推回合上，青绿被门板逐渐挡死，只剩台灯暖光和竹帘缝那道淡绿；她转回面朝屋内
第二段 近景四分之三角——她靠着门脱鞋，按脱鞋规则执行。机位在地垫斜前方约1.2米，高45厘米，与入口墙成四十五度，比第一段近得多。画面里只有关着的门扇、门框、地垫、陶砖、她膝盖以下的双腿与两只短靴，以及靠在门上的左肩与左手；焦外有拖鞋。背景不出现墙面或纵深。焦点锁在正脱那只靴
3.5-4.0秒——她左肩靠上门扇，重心移到右脚
4.0-5.3秒——左靴脱下，倒在地砖上
5.3-5.8秒——重心换到穿袜的左脚，靠着门扇稳一下
5.8-7.1秒——右靴脱下，落在第一只旁
7.1-7.5秒——两只空靴并排躺着，她双脚穿袜站定，肩离开门
第三段 全景——她走向柜子。机位比第一段近，高120厘米，正对入口墙，框住门扇与左边木柜、镜、灯
7.5-10.0秒——她从地垫穿袜向画面左边走两步到柜前，转回来面朝柜子，背朝摄影机四分之三角，台灯在她头部后方，右手伸向空柜面
第四段 微距——手袋与钥匙。机位推到柜前，正对入口墙，高95厘米与柜面齐平。瓷杯前景全焦外
10.0-11.2秒——她先把红织锦手袋放到空柜面，织锦在灯下泛金线，焦点在手袋
11.2-13.0秒——她把钥匙放在手袋旁的木面，焦点从手袋滑到钥匙上锁死：青铜钥匙9厘米、黄铜老虎挂饰3厘米，比例严格照图4；斑驳铜绿、磨损棱角、老虎身上的条纹清晰可辨。挂饰晃一下停住，一声轻响。不做戏
第五段 特写脸——她觉得屋里不对劲。机位与她眼睛齐平145厘米，正对入口墙，她转成四分之三面朝摄影机。台灯在她侧后方，脸的正面留在半影里。焦点死锁双眼
13.0-14.0秒——她直起身，肩膀松下来轻轻吐一口气，然后停住没继续落，呼吸变浅
14.0-15.0秒——她微微抬起下巴用鼻子短短吸一口气——气味迟到一拍才被认出来，不由自主的一下，不是表演性嗅闻
15.0-16.5秒——眼睛先动，头几乎不动：视线在画面外缓慢从一侧移到另一侧，落到两三个具体的点，瞳孔清楚在动。然后停住，眼神往内收一下——不是害怕，是确认了一件说不清的事。自然眨眼一次
第六段 全景——她转身往厨房走。机位回到第一段的位置和高度，正对入口墙，不动
16.5-17.6秒——头先转、身体最后跟上，她从柜边转过来面向公寓深处
17.6-19.0秒——她沿从入户门笔直进来的中轴朝摄影机走来，身形变大，台灯在她身后，脸始终逆光
19.0-19.5秒——她从摄影机旁走过出画，不看镜头
19.5-20.0秒——空画面：关着的门、亮着的台灯、竹帘缝那道淡绿、两只空靴躺在地垫边，在张力中结束
表演任务（戏全在眼睛里，绝不做表情）
动机：家是唯一能卸下来的地方。障碍：屋里有一股别人的气味。战术：身体按习惯往下走，注意力慢半拍才追上。演这半拍的延迟，不要演害怕——例行动作照常运转，中途卡住，她才开始读屋子
第五、六段：她怀疑的不是有危险，而是有人来过我家。战术是核对，像检查一件放错位置的东西；怀疑是问句不是警报。她还没紧张，肌肉不僵呼吸不屏。变化只发生在静止的质地里，不做表情
顺序硬性：眼睛先动，头跟着，身体最后，绝不允许头先动或整个人一起转。安全线：目光始终落在屋里真实的点上，静止中眼睛仍活着，不呆滞
绝对禁止：瞪大眼睛、倒抽气、夸张的屏息停顿、耸肩、皱眉、猛地扭头、惊悚片表情、对镜头表演
声音
全片无台词、无人声、无旁白、无字幕、无配乐。钥匙在旧锁里转动的金属声，木门轴干涩的吱呀声。门开着时走廊声音涌入：空调外机嗡鸣、隔壁粤语电视声、一滴水；门合上后被门板压低成闷响，不是突然切断
屋内：靴口撑开的皮革声与两靴先后落地、袜底轻响、手袋落木面的闷响、钥匙与挂饰的轻响、风扇低鸣、她放轻的呼吸。最后半秒只剩风扇和空屋房间音
正向锁定（最容易出错的几条）
1 所有光源全片一直亮着，亮度色温恒定，绝不自行开关闪烁跳变；门关上是门扇挡住外光，不是灯灭
2 六段全是完全静止的锁死机位，绝不推拉变焦摇移、不手持晃动；一颗40mm变形镜头。除第二段的四十五度近景外，机位永远正对入口墙
3 以摄影机视角为基准：左边木柜与红罩台灯，中央偏左胡桃木单扇门，右边红竹帘遮的窗——与图1一致，绝不镜像翻转
4 她跨过门槛完全进屋后才关门
5 第二段她左肩靠着关上的门扇借力；两靴一前一后脱下、绝不同时，两脚都在画面里，全程不用手碰鞋；这段背景不出现墙面
6 第四段焦点必须从手袋滑到钥匙上锁死；钥匙9厘米、挂饰3厘米，比例照图4，挂饰永远明显小于钥匙。柜面没有托盘没有热水瓶
7 门洞里直接照用图5，被门框裁窄且严重焦外，绝不是走廊纵深透视
8 青绿只在开门时大举进屋，之后只剩竹帘缝恒定的一道淡绿；绿光绝不正面照亮她的脸
9 第六段她先转身、再沿中轴朝摄影机走来、从镜头旁出画，最后留下空画面
10 构图永不居中；地面素色陶砖不是花砖；没有门链；画面里没有九十年代之后的东西。过期胶片颗粒，halation，变形椭圆焦外，超写实材质。

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: OUTSIDE-VIEW
reference_elements.description: this is what is right outside the door when we leave the apartment and look forward

Cinematic location shot, photorealistic, 35mm film still — 1990s Hong Kong, dusk, the very end of sunset. Muted natural palette, restrained faded greens only as an undertone, dominated by warm tungsten lamplight and the last light of the sky.

A long open-air gallery corridor on an upper floor of a dense high-rise housing block. Deep one-point perspective down the corridor. The walkway is NARROW — a tight typical Hong Kong gallery passage, only about two paces wide, just enough for two people to pass each other; the parapet on the left runs close to the apartment doors on the right, a compressed intimate corridor hugging the building, not a wide terrace. The corridor is LONG and clearly continues: far down at its end there is a STAIRWELL BAY — a recessed section about five paces wide holding the building's communal concrete staircase, the one residents use every day to walk up and down between floors: real concrete steps with a worn metal handrail, one flight leading down, a return flight leading up, lit by a faint lamp. The walkway runs straight into it — no dead end, no closing wall.

Right side: a row of six to seven METAL front doors — authentic Hong Kong apartment gate doors exactly like the attached references: painted metal grille gates with vertical bars — one pale blue-grey with a solid middle panel, one ornate beige with decorative leaf-pattern metalwork, others in worn green, dark grey steel, faded cream — every single door DIFFERENT, each with its own handles, locks, scratches, red good-luck banners (fai chun) pasted around the frames, small unit number plates, slippers on doormats by some thresholds. Doors set in aged plaster walls with a worn red-brown baseboard. Wide UNIFORM spacing: seven to eight paces of wall between each door and the next — and centered in every one of those wall sections, a full-size household WINDOW, human-height, with real frames: some with curtains behind the glass, some with metal grilles, a few glowing faintly from inside. The rhythm repeats all the way down: door — seven to eight paces with a window in the middle — next door. Doors never side by side; two or three doors in the near half of the frame, the rest receding.

Left side: a long balcony with a worn concrete parapet. Beyond it — end-of-sunset sky: deep blue-violet fading to a last warm amber band on the horizon, silhouettes of mismatched residential towers at different distances, a few windows already glowing warm yellow, city haze. The leafy crown of a tall tree rises from the street below beside the balcony, its top branches reaching this floor's level, softly lit by the corridor lamps.

Overhead: round ceiling lamps spaced along the corridor, warm tungsten bulbs already switched on in the dusk, casting yellow pools of light on the worn concrete floor, receding toward the stairwell.

Color grade: warm amber lamplight against the cool fading dusk sky, gentle analog film warmth, faded greens only as a quiet undertone, NO acid green, NO neon tint, natural realistic colors. Empty corridor, no people. Eye-level wide shot, strong vanishing point receding toward the stairwell bay at the far end, subtle film grain, photorealistic film still.

SCENE CONTEXT
Location study of an empty, narrow Hong Kong apartment kitchen at dusk. No people. Four static views, one per wall: the window wall, the fridge wall, the stove wall, and the entrance wall — where the open doorway looks out into the dim apartment hallway. The rooms simply exist — humming fridge, ticking clock, fading twilight, a warm lamp burning somewhere in the hallway.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<0bff2202-6484-4d8a-9f5e-d0ea62c4cdbe>>> — location reference. Narrow old galley kitchen, dusk: white tiled walls; back wall with a sheer-curtained window, two thin potted plants on the sill, lit residential towers in blue twilight outside, round clock above the window; left wall with double steel sink, worn marble counters, white gas stove and extractor hood, a small warm wall bulb over the stove; right wall with a white single-door fridge covered in magnets and a paper poster, wooden upper cabinets with a warm under-cabinet tube light, a small shelf unit, a counter with glass jars, oranges, a rice cooker and a glowing red glass lamp. Use for geography, materials, atmosphere and light sources.
<<<0400b91c-6962-4619-ad34-51b74ddaf994>>> — location reference for what lies BEYOND the kitchen doorway. Dim apartment entry hall at night: a low wooden sideboard with a black desk lamp glowing amber, a round vanity mirror on a stand, a small potted plant, a glass and a plate; above the sideboard a window covered by a bamboo roller blind with warm light bleeding through its slats; the putty-grey front door with a round brass knob and a hanging security chain, a dark red doormat; a white garment bag on wall hooks, a striped tote and worn sneakers on the tile floor. This hallway is visible ONLY through the kitchen doorway in shot D, as a deeper room in soft focus. Do not invent new rooms, furniture or windows.

FORMAT MODE
Total duration 12 seconds. Controlled four-shot sequence, 3.0s per shot, HARD CUTS at 3.0s, 6.0s and 9.0s. No transitions, no fades. The same location in every shot: same objects, same materials, same dusk light, same clock time. No people, no animals, no moving objects except curtains breathing faintly and the steady lamp glows.

OPTICS
Shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lenses. Visible organic Kodak Vision3 500T grain in shadows and midtones, gentle halation around the red lamp, the wall bulb, the hallway desk lamp and the bright window, film color response, no digital cleanliness. Anamorphic signature in every frame: vertically stretched oval bokeh on the practicals, and the left and right edges of the frame always dissolve into soft anamorphic blur — sharpness lives in the center of frame.
ALL FOUR SHOTS LENS LOCK = 47°: standard normal anamorphic character, camera 2.5 to 3 meters from each wall, natural human-eye perspective, straight tile lines rectilinear in the sharp zone, no wide-angle stretching, no telephoto compression. Same lens character in all four shots, no drift.

CAMERA
Hard camera rule: the camera NEVER moves closer or further. No dolly-in, no zoom-in, no push-in, no pull-back, no pans, no tilts mid-shot. Each shot is a fixed handheld position: breath-level rise and fall, tiny weight corrections — amplitude so small the composition does not change. Quiet voyeur feel, as if someone stands alone in the empty flat and looks at each wall in turn. Camera height: chest level in all four shots.
Shot A — from the kitchen center facing the BACK WALL: the sheer-curtained window centered, thin plants on the sill, towers glowing outside, clock above.
Shot B — from the kitchen center facing the RIGHT WALL: the fridge with magnets and poster, wooden cabinets with the warm tube light, the counter with jars, oranges, rice cooker and the glowing red lamp.
Shot C — from the kitchen center facing the LEFT WALL: the double steel sink, the gas stove and extractor hood, the small warm bulb burning over the stove, dishes and towels on the shelves.

Setting: an open-air gallery corridor on an upper floor of a residential block — a long balcony walkway with a row of apartment front doors, high above the street.

Composition: deep one-point perspective down the long corridor. From the doors to the balcony edge is about THREE PACES. The corridor is LONG, and at its far end it visibly TURNS RIGHT around the corner of the building — no staircase, no steps, no dead-end wall.

LAMPS — important: a row of ceiling lamps runs along the ENTIRE corridor — old round tungsten fixtures mounted under the ceiling slab, one after another receding into the distance, ALL SWITCHED ON, glowing warm amber-yellow, casting repeating pools of warm light on the floor, the doors and the walls, clearly the main light source of the scene. Right side: a row of METAL front doors — each one different: grey steel, green-painted iron, dark metal gate, faded blue-grey, with real handles, locks and scratches. Between one door and the next: FIVE TO SIX PACES of wall with a proper full-size household window set into it — real frames, some with curtains, some with metal grilles, a few glowing faintly from inside. Doors never side by side; two or three doors in the near half of the frame, the rest receding.

Left side: the balcony edge is an open METAL RAILING — waist-high balustrade of thin vertical bars with a rounded handrail, old worn paint. LAUNDRY dries ON THE RAILING ONLY: large bath towels draped over the handrail, socks and small clothes pinned to short lines strung low along the balustrade between its posts. NOTHING hangs from the ceiling — no clothes on the ceiling, no hangers overhead, the space above the walkway is completely clear. Beyond the railing — the evening city: high-rise towers with many warm lit windows, soft haze; in the courtyard below a tall tree grows up toward the building, its crown just reaching this floor's level, dimly catching the corridor light.

Grade: warm yellow lamplight dominating against the deep blue-green evening outside — restrained  palette, light soft green tint in the dusk air, NOT acid, NOT neon. Fine 35mm film grain, worn concrete floor, aged plaster, exposed pipes along the ceiling. Empty corridor, no people. Eye-level wide shot, strong vanishing point, the walkway receding and turning right in the distance, photorealistic film still.

The corridor is LONG, and at its far end it visibly TURNS RIGHT around the corner of the building — no staircase anywhere, no steps, no dead-end wall, just the walkway bending right and continuing out of sight.

Right side: a row of EIGHT metal front doors along the corridor, with STRICTLY UNIFORM spacing — the rhythm repeats evenly: door — five to six paces of wall with a window — next door, the same interval every time, all the way down. The doors are authentic Hong Kong apartment gate doors, exactly like the attached references: painted metal grille gates with vertical bars — one pale blue-grey with a solid middle panel, one ornate beige with decorative leaf-pattern metalwork, others in worn green, dark grey steel, faded cream — each with real handles and locks, red good-luck banners (fai chun) pasted on and around the door frames, small unit number plates, stickers, a pair of slippers or shoes on the doormat by some thresholds. Every door photorealistic, aged, believable — real Hong Kong texture. In each wall section between doors: a full-size household window with real frames, some with curtains behind the glass, some with metal grilles, a few glowing faintly from inside. Doors never stand side by side; two or three doors in the near half of the frame, the rest receding evenly with perspective.

Left side: the balcony edge is an open METAL RAILING — a waist-high balustrade of thin vertical metal bars with a rounded handrail on top, old painted metal, worn and slightly chipped, see-through. Laundry dries on the railing: large bath towels draped over the handrail at several spots along the walkway, socks and small clothes pinned to short lines strung low along the balustrade — everyday lived-in laundry, nothing hanging from the ceiling. Beyond the railing — the evening city: high-rise towers of different heights in the distance, scattered warm lit windows, soft haze. In the courtyard below, a tall tree grows up toward the building, its leafy crown just reaching the level of this floor at the railing.

Lighting: warm YELLOW is the dominant light — old tungsten lamps under the ceiling glow amber-yellow, casting warm pools along the walkway and on the doors. Outside, beyond the railing, the ambience carries a light, soft green tint — gentle, muted, filmic, NOT acid, NOT neon, NOT oversaturated.

Grade: warm yellow lamplight inside the corridor balanced against the soft green-tinted evening outside — restrained  palette, fine 35mm film grain, natural textures: worn concrete floor, aged plaster, exposed pipes along the ceiling. Empty corridor, no people. Eye-level wide shot, strong vanishing point, the walkway receding and turning right in the distance, photorealistic film still.

电影感实景剧照，写实风格，35mm胶片。必须看起来是真实存在的拍摄地——像真正在老居民楼取景的电影画面，真实的岁月痕迹和生活细节，绝无CG感、无3D渲染感、无布景感。

时间：日落刚过的蓝调时刻——太阳已落下，深蓝暮空，几朵泛蓝灰的云，无直射光，柔和冷蓝的环境光。

场景：1990年代香港老居民楼上层的露天外廊，高于街面——不是汽车旅馆，不是临街底层。天花板是上层楼板，沿天花板和墙壁走着裸露的金属管道——水管、电线管、生锈的排水管，真实感十足。

构图：沿走廊纵深的单点透视。走廊狭窄，宽度约两步，刚够两人擦肩而过。地面是磨旧的水泥地，残留斑驳的旧绿漆。

左侧：低矮混凝土护栏，顶部一根深棕红色金属圆管扶手，油漆磨损。护栏外是落差和真实的城市纵深：对面是同小区的另一栋楼翼，一排排相同的外廊，部分亮着淡绿荧光灯；更远处是暮色中高低错落的住宅楼，零星暖黄窗光。一棵高树从楼下长上来，树冠顶端刚好探到这层护栏边。

右侧：一排金属入户门，共6–7扇，每扇都不同——灰色钢板门、绿漆铁门、掉漆的深色铁栅门、褪色蓝灰金属门，真实的把手、锁具、贴纸、刮痕。每扇门后是一整套住宅，门与门之间隔着长长的空白墙——从一扇门到下一扇要走7–8步，其间的墙上有带铁栅栏的小厨房窗，有的开着缝、有的挂着旧窗帘。门绝不紧挨。近景只有两三扇门，其余随透视远去。

楼梯——关键设定：楼梯不藏在走廊深处，而是一座凸出于楼体外侧的独立开放式楼梯塔，紧贴外墙、悬在半空中，像参考照片里那样：之字形来回折返的露天楼梯，绿漆台阶，黑色金属栏杆，混凝土梯板外露，从走廊尽头直接走出去就踏上这座外挂楼梯，可以看到梯段在楼体外一层层往下折返，暮色中轮廓清晰。走廊尽头是开放的，通向这座楼梯塔，不是死墙。

灯光：天花板下的老式荧光灯管，淡绿色调柔和光——王家卫式色调，温和、胶片感，绝不刺眼、不是霓虹绿、不过饱和。冷绿灯光与深蓝暮空、零星暖黄窗光形成安静对比。

色调：克制的王家卫配色——青蓝暮色、淡绿灯光、旧绿漆地面与台阶、混凝土灰、点缀暖窗光。走廊空无一人。平视广角，强烈消失点，尽头通向外挂楼梯塔，细腻胶片颗粒，真实电影剧照。The stairs is logical placed.

右侧：一排金属入户门，共6–7扇，每扇都不同——灰色钢板门、绿漆铁门、掉漆的深色铁栅门、褪色蓝灰金属门，真实的把手、锁具、贴纸、刮痕。每扇门后是一整套住宅，门与门之间隔着长长的空白墙——从一扇门到下一扇要走7–8步，其间的墙上有带铁栅栏的小厨房窗，有的开着缝、有的挂着旧窗帘。门绝不紧挨。近景只有两三扇门，其余随透视远去。

楼梯——关键设定：楼梯不藏在走廊深处，而是一座凸出于楼体外侧的独立开放式楼梯塔，紧贴外墙、悬在半空中，像参考照片里那样：之字形来回折返的露天楼梯，绿漆台阶，黑色金属栏杆，混凝土梯板外露，从走廊尽头直接走出去就踏上这座外挂楼梯，可以看到梯段在楼体外一层层往下折返，暮色中轮廓清晰。走廊尽头是开放的，通向这座楼梯塔，不是死墙。

灯光：天花板下的老式荧光灯管，淡绿色调柔和光——王家卫式色调，温和、胶片感，绝不刺眼、不是霓虹绿、不过饱和。冷绿灯光与深蓝暮空、零星暖黄窗光形成安静对比。

色调：克制的王家卫配色——青蓝暮色、淡绿灯光、旧绿漆地面与台阶、混凝土灰、点缀暖窗光。走廊空无一人。平视广角，强烈消失点，尽头通向外挂楼梯塔，细腻胶片颗粒，真实电影剧照。The stairs is logical placed.

场景：1990年代香港高层住宅大厦第七层的露天外廊，远高于街面——不是汽车旅馆，不是平房。天花板是上层楼板，沿着天花板和墙壁走着裸露的金属管道——水管、电线管、生锈的排水管，管线纵横交错，充满真实感。

Character portrait prompt — Grandmother, ~70, Hong Kong Chinese (full face, raw realism, non-idealized)
Cinematic character portrait, hyper-photorealistic, 35mm anamorphic film still, documentary-style. The entire face fully visible and centered, head-and-shoulders framing with a little room around the head — the complete face in view from forehead to chin, nothing cropped. An ordinary elderly woman around 70 years old, ethnic Chinese, born and raised in Hong Kong. Not glamorous, not retouched — a real, lived-in face. Her expression is warm and human: a soft, slightly uneven genuine smile that reaches her eyes, brows a little raised in quiet curiosity, a faint tiredness behind a kind gaze.
Grey-white hair, uneven and thinning at the temples, pinned up in a slightly imperfect low bun with loose flyaway silver strands. The skin is unidealized and asymmetrical: deep uneven wrinkles, sagging eyelids and under-eye bags, blotchy patches, broken capillaries and redness around the nose and cheeks, an uneven scatter of brown age spots and small skin tags, a couple of stray coarse hairs on the chin, dry flaking on the lips, shiny oily patches on the forehead and nose, enlarged pores, dull uneven skin tone. Slightly crooked, discolored teeth just visible in the smile. Her eyes are real and imperfect — dark irises with faded pigment and a pale cloudy ring (arcus senilis), slightly watery and bloodshot, fine red veins in the yellowish whites, uneven lower lashes. Faint natural facial asymmetry, one eye slightly smaller. Modest, worn everyday clothing in faded muted tones.
Plain neutral grey studio background, plain even soft key light — flat and honest, not flattering, revealing every texture and flaw. Anamorphic lens characteristics: oval elliptical bokeh, horizontally stretched out-of-focus highlights, smooth background blur, shallow depth of field with the eyes in sharp focus. No lens flares, no streaks. Muted, slightly desaturated cinematic grade, natural imperfect skin tones, visible film grain, eye-level, head-and-shoulders, 50mm-equivalent framing.

A candid, true-to-life photograph that feels like a frame from a real film shot in a real lived-in flat, 35mm anamorphic film still, photorealistic, no people, nothing staged. A tiny, genuine Hong Kong studio apartment (~3.6 by 6 meters, one single room) where a young woman actually lives — evening, rainy blue hour outside. The layout, always identical: the front metal-framed door opens onto a short entry zone; just inside on the right, a slim built-in shoe cabinet with a ceramic tray holding keys and a hair tie, a phone charging cable, a half-finished cup of tea, one framed photo, a small succulent, and a round mirror above it lit by a warm yellow tungsten wall light — the only warm lamp, pouring a golden-amber pool onto the tiles. On the left wall by the door: hooks with a light jacket and a slightly damp folded umbrella, a sports duffel bag leaning below, women's shoes mostly paired on a low rack, one pair slightly askew by the doormat. Just past the shoe cabinet on the right, a bathroom door slightly ajar, darkness inside. Straight ahead from the door, the far wall is the kitchen: a compact counter with a sink beneath an aluminium-framed window that glows with cold rainy blue city light and faint distant neon, a drying rack with two cups, a refrigerator in the far right corner, a small two-burner stove on the left end, and a pale green fluorescent tube on the kitchen ceiling washing the counter in soft greenish light. Along the left wall, the living nook: a neat sofa-bed with cushions and a folded throw, above it a wooden shelf where a few sports medals hang and two small cups stand naturally among books, framed photos and a plant — a modest engraved plaque, lived-with, not a trophy case; a small glowing aquarium with a few little fish on a low cabinet, a warm floor lamp in the corner. Between the living nook and the kitchen, a small round table with a clear glass vase. Authentic Hong Kong studio: glossy cream ceramic-tile floor with tiny wear at the edges, smooth painted walls in a soft muted jade-green tint with faint scuffs near the skirting, compact custom cabinetry using every centimeter, everything orderly and cared-for — feminine, disciplined, quietly personal, tidy but busy, utterly believable.  palette: golden-amber tungsten against pale green fluorescent and the cold rainy blue of the window, deep saturated yellows and greens over deep natural blacks, muted filmic grade, fine film grain, faint humid haze, pooled light rather than even illumination, half-dark, a subtle sense that something is off. Physically accurate and flawless: correct perspective and proportions, clean straight lines, no distortion, no warped or duplicated objects, no artifacts, no garbled text. Quiet, intimate, a little tense but neutral, understated and true-to-life.
Camera: wide master shot from the open front doorway, eye-level, single-point perspective straight across the studio to the glowing kitchen window above the sink at the far end; shoe cabinet and ajar bathroom door on the right, hooks and living nook edge on the left; shallow depth of field, anamorphic oval bokeh on the window light. 16:9.

Cinematic wide establishing shot, photorealistic, 35mm anamorphic film still. A small, lived-in Hong Kong apartment kitchen at dusk, wide shot down the length of the narrow room from its entrance, camera at chest height, gently asymmetric three-quarter view, full floor-to-ceiling view with room for a standing figure head to toe. In the near foreground, entering the left edge of the frame, a soft out-of-focus open shelf stacked with household things — glass jars, folded towels, a thermos — framing the shot.

Every wall is covered floor to ceiling in aged glossy white square ceramic tiles, chipped and yellowed by years of cooking. The layout, wall by wall. Left wall: a white gas stove with an oven, a striped towel hanging over the oven door handle, an old range hood above it with a flexible duct climbing the tiles, worn wooden cabinets and a narrow counter beyond. Back wall, centered: a window with a deep sill — thin white lace curtains drawn across only half of it, the other half open clear glass; on the sill two small potted plants; through the open half, slightly out of focus, the massive facade of a Hong Kong high-rise block against a fading blue-grey dusk sky, a dim grid of lit and dark windows. To the left of the window, in the back corner, a large glass aquarium sits on a sturdy low wooden stand — a long tank of clear still water, unlit, with soft green aquatic plants swaying gently inside, a gravel bottom with smooth pebbles and a small piece of driftwood, and five tiny bright orange goldfish drifting slowly between the plants, their scales catching faint glints of the warm room light. On the other side of the window, to its right, a tall white refrigerator stands against the back wall with clear open floor around it — the nearest furniture is a full step away, its door has full room to swing wide open; the fridge door is dotted with magnets and a small paper calendar. A round wall clock hangs above the window. Right wall: starting well past the refrigerator, a long run of worn wooden upper cabinets, a small wooden spice shelf, a steel sink with a few dishes drying, glass jars, an old rice cooker with a few bright oranges piled beside it; at the far end of the right wall a brown wooden door with two aprons on hooks, a broom leaning in the corner, and beside the door a low wooden cabinet with a small red-shaded table lamp glowing on top of it.

The room sits in near-darkness — the ceiling light is off, lit only by a few small sources: the warm under-cabinet lamp over the right counter, a tiny bulb over the stove, and the small red lamp by the door throwing a soft red pool onto the tiles. Cool blue dusk seeps in through the open half of the window and the lace. Deep soft shadows pool everywhere else — quiet, slightly uneasy, as if someone could be standing just out of frame. The room is completely empty and still. Anamorphic lens characteristics: oval elliptical bokeh, horizontally stretched out-of-focus highlights, smooth painterly background blur, shallow depth of field. No lens flares, no streaks. Warm muted cinematic grade with gentle haze, quiet  atmosphere, subtle film grain, eye-level, wide framing. No people, no text. No plastic look, no cartoon, no 3D render, no illustration, no CGI.

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

Cinematic location shot, photorealistic, 35mm film still. A long open-air gallery corridor of a dense 1990s Hong Kong public housing block — a crowded "human anthill" residential estate, evening. Deep one-point perspective down the corridor. A candid, true-to-life photograph that feels like a frame from a real film shot in a real lived-in flat, 35mm anamorphic film still, photorealistic, no people, nothing staged. A small, genuine Hong Kong studio apartment — an elongated single room about 3.6 by 7.5 meters, a good eight to ten steps from the front door to the kitchen window at the far end — where a young woman actually lives; evening, rainy blue hour outside. The layout, always identical: the front metal-framed door opens onto an entry zone; just inside on the right, a slim built-in shoe cabinet with a ceramic tray holding keys and a hair tie, a phone charging cable, a half-finished cup of tea, one framed photo, a small succulent, and a round mirror above it lit by a warm yellow tungsten wall light — the only warm lamp, pouring a golden-amber pool onto the tiles while the rest of the right side stays in darkness. On the left wall by the door: hooks with a light jacket and a slightly damp folded umbrella, a sports duffel bag leaning below, women's shoes mostly paired on a low rack, one pair slightly askew by the doormat. The right side of the flat is a natural shadow zone with believable hiding places: just past the shoe cabinet a bathroom door stands slightly ajar with darkness inside, and further along the right wall a tall slim wardrobe juts out, creating a deep unlit recess between itself and the bathroom — walking in, her eyeline naturally goes to the lit kitchen ahead, never to that dark right side. Straight ahead, the far wall is the kitchen: a compact counter with a sink beneath an aluminium-framed window that glows with cold rainy blue city light and faint distant neon, a drying rack with two cups, a refrigerator in the far right corner with a handwritten grocery list under a magnet, a small two-burner stove on the left end, and a pale green fluorescent tube on the kitchen ceiling washing the counter in soft greenish light. At the end of the kitchen counter, on its own sturdy low cabinet beside the fridge, a beautiful well-kept home aquarium — clear glass, softly lit water with a gentle green-blue glow, a few small bright fish, live plants and dark pebbles, a tidy air stone trailing fine bubbles — realistic and loved, its light rippling faintly on the counter. Along the left wall, the living nook: a neat sofa-bed with pastel cushions and a folded throw, above it a wooden shelf where a few sports medals hang and two small cups stand naturally among books, framed photos and a plant — a modest engraved plaque, lived-with, not a trophy case; a warm floor lamp in the corner, a soft rug, a wall calendar with handwritten training marks. Between the living nook and the kitchen, a small round table with a clear glass vase. Every detail reflects her character — disciplined and athletic yet gentle and feminine: order without sterility, plants she waters, photos she framed, medals she doesn't show off. Authentic Hong Kong studio: glossy cream ceramic-tile floor with tiny wear at the edges, smooth painted walls in a soft muted jade-green tint with faint scuffs near the skirting, compact custom cabinetry using every centimeter, tidy but busy, utterly believable.  palette: golden-amber tungsten against pale green fluorescent and the cold rainy blue of the window, deep saturated yellows and greens over deep natural blacks, muted filmic grade, fine film grain, faint humid haze, pooled light rather than even illumination, half-dark, a subtle sense that something is off. Physically accurate and flawless: correct perspective and proportions, clean straight lines, no distortion, no warped or duplicated objects, no artifacts, no garbled text. Quiet, intimate, a little tense but neutral, understated and true-to-life. Camera: wide master shot from the open front doorway, eye-level, single-point perspective straight across the studio to the glowing kitchen window above the sink at the far end; shoe cabinet and ajar bathroom door on the right, hooks and living nook edge on the left; shallow depth of field, anamorphic oval bokeh on the window light. 16:9.

电影感实景剧照，写实风格，35mm胶片。必须看起来是一个真实存在的拍摄地——像真正在老居民楼里取景拍摄的电影画面，有真实的岁月痕迹和生活细节，绝不能有CG感、3D渲染感或人工布景感。

时间：日落刚过的蓝调时刻——太阳已落下，深蓝色暮空，几朵泛蓝灰的云，无直射光，柔和的冷蓝环境光笼罩城市。

场景：1990年代香港高层住宅大厦第七层的露天外廊，远高于街面——不是汽车旅馆，不是平房。天花板是上层楼板，沿着天花板和墙壁走着裸露的金属管道——水管、电线管、生锈的排水管，管线纵横交错，充满真实感。

构图：沿走廊纵深的单点透视，参考第二张实景照片的机位。走廊狭窄，宽度约两步，刚够两人擦肩而过。地面是磨旧的水泥地，残留着斑驳褪色的旧绿漆。

左侧：低矮的混凝土护栏，顶上装着一根深棕红色的金属圆管扶手，油漆磨损。护栏外是深深的落差和真实的城市纵深：对面是同一小区的另一栋楼翼，能看到一排排一模一样的外廊和护栏，部分走廊亮着淡绿的荧光灯；更远处是高低错落、风格各异的其他住宅塔楼，零星窗户透出暖黄灯光，其余沉在蓝色暮霭中。一棵高大的树从楼下街道长上来，树冠顶端刚好探到这层护栏边。

右侧：一排金属入户门，共6–7扇——都是金属门，但每扇都不同：灰色钢板门、绿漆铁门、掉漆的深色铁栅门、褪色的蓝灰色金属门，各有真实的把手、锁具、贴纸和刮痕。每扇门后是一整套住宅，门与门之间隔着长长的空白墙面——从一扇门走到下一扇需要7–8步。门与门之间的墙上有带铁栅栏的小窗户——真实的厨房窗，有的开着缝，有的挂着窗帘，窗框老旧。门绝不紧挨，不能排成储物柜。近景只有两三扇门，其余随透视远去。

走廊尽头：清晰可见的开放式混凝土楼梯间——真实的公共楼梯，带金属扶手，台阶向下通往楼下、回转梯段向上，梯级上残留旧绿漆，由一盏小灯照亮。走廊直接通进楼梯间，尽头不是死墙。

灯光：天花板下的老式荧光灯管，淡绿色调的柔和光——王家卫式的色调，温和、胶片感，绝不是刺眼荧光绿、不是霓虹。冷绿灯光与深蓝暮空、远处零星暖黄窗光形成安静的对比。

色调：王家卫式的克制配色——青蓝暮色、淡绿灯光、磨旧的绿漆地面、混凝土的灰，点缀暖黄窗光。走廊空无一人。平视广角，强烈的消失点直指尽头楼梯间，细腻胶片颗粒，真实电影剧照。

An elderly woman around 70 years old, ethnic Chinese, born and raised in Hong Kong. Thin, pale lips with soft vertical lines, a small mole near the mouth. Modest simple clothing in muted earth tones.
Plain neutral grey studio background, even soft key light with a gentle falloff that sculpts the wrinkles and skin texture. 第2步：门外暖琥珀球灯的光涌进来，在陶砖上铺长楔形；走廊深处的冷青绿作第二层。她在这道光里成为逆光的深色身影
第3步：她跨过门槛，整个人朝摄影机方向走进屋内，站到地垫上。此时她已完全在屋里，摄影机与她之间不再隔着门扇。右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋

第1步：左手撑门框，重心移到右脚
第2步：右脚尖踩住左靴后跟外沿向下压住，左脚跟先脱出、整只脚抽出，左靴空着倒在地砖上不再移动
第3步：短暂停顿，重心换到穿袜的左脚，借门框稳一下
第4步：穿袜的左脚尖踩住右靴后跟外沿向下压住，右脚跟先脱出、整只脚抽出，右靴落在第一只旁不再移动
第5步：她双脚穿袜站在地垫上，两只空靴并排躺着。拖鞋全程不动，这一段不去穿

3.4-4.4秒——左靴脱下，倒在地砖上

5.8-6.0秒——两只空靴并排躺着，她双脚穿袜站定，左手离开门框
第三段 全景——她走向柜子。机位比第一段近，高120厘米，正对入口墙，框住门扇与左边木柜、圆镜、台灯
6.0-8.5秒——她从地垫出发，穿袜向画面左边走两步到柜前，转回来面朝柜子，背朝摄影机呈四分之三角，台灯在她头部后方，右手伸向空柜面。方向从中间往左，绝不从画面右边入画

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

四色和弦：暖琥珀#E99D25为主，漆红#BA0101在竹帘与灯罩上作最响重音，青玉绿#ADD794只在最深处作冷对位，其余压进#040011。白偏金，灰偏青玉，阴影压到近黑不发灰
对白与声音
全片无台词、无人声、无旁白、无字幕、无配乐。钥匙在旧锁里转动的金属声，木门轴干涩的吱呀声。门一开走廊声音涌入：空调外机嗡鸣、隔壁粤语电视声、一滴水落下；门合上之后被干净切断。屋内：靴口撑开的皮革声与两只靴子先后落地、袜底轻响、手袋落到木面的闷响、钥匙碰木面的轻响、远处风扇低鸣、她放轻的呼吸。第五段只剩风扇、变浅的呼吸和一次极轻的吸气
正向锁定（最容易出错的几条）
1 五段全是完全静止的锁死机位，绝不推拉变焦摇移、绝不手持晃动；一颗40mm变形镜头，永远正对入口墙
2 以摄影机视角为唯一基准：左边木柜与红罩台灯，中央偏左胡桃木单扇门，右边红竹帘遮住的窗——与图1一致，绝不镜像翻转。竹帘后是窗不是房间，入口区只有这一扇窗
3 她跨过门槛完全进屋后才关门
4 切尔西套穿短靴，两只一前一后脱下、绝不同时，左手全程撑门框，两只脚都在画面里，拖鞋不动
5 柜面空着，手袋和钥匙直接放木面上，没有托盘没有热水瓶；她走向柜子的起点永远是门前地垫，方向从画面中间往左，绝不从右边缘入画
6 门洞里的内容直接照用图5——对面的墨绿栏杆与焦外夜城，被门框裁窄且严重焦外；绝不是走廊的纵深透视
7 她的脸全片从未被直接照亮，冷青绿绝不上脸。第五段眼睛先动、头跟着、身体最后
8 构图永不居中；地面素色陶砖不是花砖；没有门链；画面里没有九十年代之后的东西。过期胶片颗粒，halation，变形椭圆焦外，超写实材质，实拍电影质感。

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: OUTSIDE-VIEW
reference_elements.description: this is what is right outside the door when we leave the apartment and look forward

params.prompt:
A clean plate for the doorway composite: the view from inside her flat toward the open
side of the access gallery, mid-1990s Hong Kong, night — no door, no door frame, no walls
in shot, only the view itself, geometry locked for the seam.

Camera: 2.5 meters back from the entry wall, lens height 110 centimeters, a gentle upward
tilt — so the railing's thick round top rail runs exactly along the horizon line of the
frame, dead level, and the seam will sit invisibly in the doorway. Perspective true to
that height and tilt: a narrow strip of the walkway floor at the bottom of frame, the
railing at mid-height, the city and black sky taking the upper half.

The walkway strip: worn concrete, a metre and a half deep, holding a faint damp sheen —
washed in a dim cool green, the spill of a distant fluorescent tube far down the gallery
and the dark dome lamps overhead giving almost nothing; no warm pool, the gallery sleeps
in green shadow.

The railing: closely spaced vertical iron bars with a thick round top rail, painted dark
jade-green, chipped and worn at the joints; a brown bath towel draped heavily over the
rail left of centre, two pale cloths hanging beside it, a sagging string with wooden
clothes pegs strung between the posts; everything beaded faintly with damp, the green
paint catching a dull emerald sheen from the distant tube light.

Beyond the railing, filling the upper half: the night city at true distance — hundreds of
metres across the district: dense residential towers higher than our third floor, endless
grids of small warm tungsten windows climbing into a pure black sky, the rounded crown of
one taller tower glowing at its rim on the left; low warm haze of street light and one
soft red glow pooling far below between the blocks; the farthest towers dissolving into
humid darkness. The warm gold of the city against the green-black of the gallery — the
only warmth in the frame lives across the gap.

Physics honest: railing two metres from camera, sharp; the city truly far, its windows
small and dense, atmospheric; light levels believable — the city glows brighter than the
unlit walkway; contact shadows true; no rain streaks, only humid haze.

Expired-35mm Wong Kar-wai chemistry: deep green-teal shadow world against distant golden
windows, violet-black sky, nothing neutral. Anamorphic 40mm, 16:9: focus on the railing
and the towel, the city melting into oval anamorphic bokeh — every window a soft
horizontally-stretched golden disc; heavy natural film grain, gentle halation on the
distant lights, milky humid haze. No people, no doors, no lamps in frame. A photograph,
not a render.

Edit this image. Change ONLY the two light sources — everything else stays pixel-perfect identical: same composition, corridor, doors with the tiger, railing with towels, stairwell, city buildings, no crop, no zoom.

1. LAMPS TURN GREEN: all the ceiling lamps along the corridor now emit a pale GREEN fluorescent light — the same family as the stairwell tube. Their green glow falls realistically on everything they touch: the ceiling around them, the white walls, the doors, the concrete floor — cold green pools with natural falloff replacing the warm amber. The dead lamps stay dead. The whole corridor now lives in green light, moderate and filmic, NOT acid, NOT neon-bright.

2. CITY GLOWS ORANGE: the city beyond the railing radiates warm ORANGE light — the thousands of windows burn orange-amber, a warm orange haze rises from the streets below and wraps the towers, soft orange halation around the brightest clusters; the pink-red neon sign may stay as an accent. The orange city glow spills faintly onto the railing and the towels — a warm rim from outside against the green corridor.

Keep the 5th-floor height: the towers rise well above the camera, street glow close below. Same dark oppressive night, same colors, photorealistic, no film grain.

POV from inside the dark entry of her flat, mid-1990s Hong Kong, night — the front door has
just swung open, and the frame is what she sees standing on her doormat: the doorway as a
tall bright rectangle cut into the darkness of the flat, and through it — the gallery and
the city.

Geometry, physically correct: the camera stands about a metre and a half inside the flat at
eye level, square to the doorway. The walnut door leaf is swung fully inward to the left,
its wood grain catching a faint red-amber edge from the table lamp off-frame left; the
brass lever handle glints. The doorway is a true door's proportion — about two metres tall,
eighty centimetres wide — and it frames the view in honest perspective: first the threshold
and the coir doormat at the bottom, then the access-gallery walkway, barely a metre and a
half deep, its worn concrete floor holding a damp sheen and one warm pool of light from a
dome lamp just above the doorway, out of frame; then the gallery balustrade — closely
spaced vertical iron bars with a thick round top rail, painted dark jade-green, the paint
worn, a brown towel draped over the rail slightly right of centre, a string with clothes
pegs sagging between posts; the wrought-iron gate stands open flat against the outside
wall, a sliver of it visible at the doorway's right edge.

Beyond and below the railing, the night city of Hong Kong at a believable distance —
hundreds of metres across the district: dense residential towers rising higher than us,
grids of small warm tungsten windows climbing into the black sky, the rounded crown of one
taller tower lit at its top far left, and one tall vertical neon sign in saturated red
Chinese characters burning among the towers right of centre, its glow doubled faintly in
the humid air; lower rooftops of old blocks in the foreground gap, a few dim rooftop lights.
Fine drizzle drifts past the railing, catching the dome lamp's warmth as tiny sparks; the
city beyond softens in haze. No moon, no stars — only the city's own light.

Exposure is honest: the gallery and city are brighter than the flat, so the interior
surrounding the doorway falls into deep violet-black — the door frame, the yellow wall and
the edge of the cabinet reading only as dark shapes with one red-amber whisper from the
lamp; the beige slippers just visible at the bottom corner of the threshold. The doorway
itself is the picture: warm tungsten walkway, green railing, golden towers, red neon, black
sky — a frame within the frame.

Expired-35mm Wong Kar-wai chemistry: saturated ambers and reds against violet-black,
nothing neutral. Anamorphic 40mm, 16:9: focus on the railing and the towel, the city
melting into oval bokeh — every distant window a soft horizontal-stretched disc, the neon
sign a glowing smear of red; heavy natural grain, halation on the lamp pool and the neon,
milky humid haze. Physically accurate: single-point perspective through the doorway,
correct scale between doorway, walkway, railing and distant towers, true contact shadows,
no impossible reflections, no text readable except the blurred neon characters. No people.
A photograph, not a render. <<<45459fc7-816e-4444-931d-19ddb55d72a4>>> <<<3c8395b4-538e-4294-9182-e6e641c7bb11>>>

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

Total duration 12 seconds. Controlled four-shot sequence, 3.0s per shot, HARD CUTS at 3.0s, 6.0s and 9.0s. No transitions, no fades. A candid, true-to-life photograph that feels like a frame from a real film shot in a real lived-in flat, 35mm anamorphic film still, photorealistic, no people, nothing staged. A small, genuine Hong Kong studio apartment — an elongated single room about 3.6 by 7.5 meters, a good eight to ten steps from the front door to the kitchen window at the far end — where a young woman actually lives; evening, rainy blue hour outside. The layout, always identical: the front metal-framed door opens onto an entry zone; just inside on the right, a slim built-in shoe cabinet with a ceramic tray holding keys and a hair tie, a phone charging cable, a half-finished cup of tea, one framed photo, a small succulent, and a round mirror above it lit by a warm yellow tungsten wall light — the only warm lamp, pouring a golden-amber pool onto the tiles while the rest of the right side stays in darkness. The right side of the flat is a natural shadow zone with believable hiding places: just past the shoe cabinet a bathroom door stands slightly ajar with darkness inside, and further along the right wall a tall slim wardrobe juts out, creating a deep unlit recess between itself and the bathroom — walking in, her eyeline naturally goes to the lit kitchen ahead, never to that dark right side. Straight ahead, the far wall is the kitchen: a compact counter with a sink beneath an aluminium-framed window that glows with cold rainy blue city light and faint distant neon, a drying rack with two cups, a refrigerator in the far right corner with a handwritten grocery list under a magnet, a small two-burner stove on the left end, and a pale green fluorescent tube on the kitchen ceiling washing the counter in soft greenish light. At the end of the kitchen counter, on its own sturdy low cabinet beside the fridge, a beautiful well-kept home aquarium — clear glass, softly lit water with a gentle green-blue glow, a few small bright fish, live plants and dark pebbles, a tidy air stone trailing fine bubbles — realistic and loved, its light rippling faintly on the counter. Along the left wall, the living nook: a neat sofa-bed with pastel cushions and a folded throw, above it a wooden shelf where a few sports medals hang and two small cups stand naturally among books, framed photos and a plant — a modest engraved plaque, lived-with, not a trophy case; a warm floor lamp in the corner, a soft rug, a wall calendar with handwritten training marks. Between the living nook and the kitchen, a small round table with a clear glass vase. Every detail reflects her character — disciplined and athletic yet gentle and feminine: order without sterility, plants she waters, photos she framed, medals she doesn't show off. 电影感实景剧照，写实风格，35mm胶片。必须看起来是真实存在的拍摄地——像真正在老居民楼取景的电影画面，真实的岁月痕迹和生活细节，绝无CG感、无3D渲染感、无布景感。

时间：日落刚过的蓝调时刻——太阳已落下，深蓝暮空，几朵泛蓝灰的云，无直射光，柔和冷蓝的环境光。

场景：1990年代香港老居民楼上层的露天外廊，高于街面——不是汽车旅馆，不是临街底层。天花板是上层楼板，沿天花板和墙壁走着裸露的金属管道——水管、电线管、生锈的排水管，真实感十足。

构图：沿走廊纵深的单点透视。走廊狭窄，宽度约两步，刚够两人擦肩而过。地面是磨旧的水泥地，残留斑驳的旧绿漆。

进门规则——逐步编排（硬性，不许改顺序）
第1步：钥匙转动，门扇以左缘铰链为轴向屋内划开，自由边由右向左朝摄影机摆过来，短暂遮住左边的木柜；门洞右半侧空出来
第2步：门外暖琥珀球灯的光涌进来，在陶砖上铺长楔形；走廊深处的冷青绿作第二层。她在这道光里成为逆光的深色身影
第3步：她跨过门槛，整个人朝摄影机方向走进屋内，站到地垫上。此时她已完全在屋里，摄影机与她之间不再隔着门扇。右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋
第4步：她上半身转回身后，右手扶门扇右缘，把门由左向右推回合上。两层光一起熄灭，只剩柜上的红罩台灯
第5步：她转回来面朝屋内，站在地垫上
绝对禁止：站在门外关门；留在门洞里不进屋；隔着门扇做动作；关门时人在门另一侧；关门后还在走廊里
脱鞋规则——逐步编排（硬性，两只靴子一前一后，绝不同时）
鞋型硬性：切尔西式套穿短靴——两侧弹力松紧布，后跟一个提耳，没有拉链没有鞋带，可以只用另一只脚的鞋尖蹬下来
起始：她站在地垫上，双脚各穿一只，共两只鞋，鞋内深色棉袜。右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋，左手从腋下伸出撑住门框——全程有支撑点，身体绝不悬空摇摆。两只脚全程在画面内
第1步：左手撑门框，重心移到右脚
第2步：右脚尖踩住左靴后跟外沿向下压住，左脚跟先脱出、整只脚抽出，左靴空着倒在地砖上不再移动
第3步：短暂停顿，重心换到穿袜的左脚，借门框稳一下

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

5.8-6.0秒——两只空靴并排躺着，她双脚穿袜站定，左手离开门框
第三段 全景——她走向柜子。机位比第一段近，高120厘米，正对入口墙，框住门扇与左边木柜、圆镜、台灯
6.0-8.5秒——她从地垫出发，穿袜向画面左边走两步到柜前，转回来面朝柜子，背朝摄影机呈四分之三角，台灯在她头部后方，右手伸向空柜面。方向从中间往左，绝不从画面右边入画
第四段 特写——她放下手袋和钥匙。机位推到柜前，仍正对入口墙，高95厘米，与柜面齐平的微距，瓷杯前景全焦外
8.5-9.4秒——她先把红织锦手袋放到空柜面上，织锦在灯下泛起金线
9.4-10.0秒——她的手很随意地把钥匙放在手袋旁的木面上，一声轻响，手收回出画。日常动作，不停顿不迟疑不做戏
第五段 全景——她察觉屋里有别人。机位后撤、高130厘米，正对入口墙，全段一动不动。她在画面左侧三分之一站柜边，右侧是竹帘那面深红的负空间与黑。焦点锁头肩
10.0-11.0秒——她直起身，手离开柜面，肩膀松下来，轻轻吐一口气。回家的动作做完了
11.0-11.9秒——她没有动，但松下来的肩膀停住了、没有继续落；呼吸变轻，不是屏住只是变浅。重心悄悄从一只脚挪成两脚均分——从随便站着变成站稳
11.9-12.8秒——她微微抬起下巴，用鼻子短短吸一口气。这是气味迟到一拍才被认出来时不由自主的一下，不是表演性嗅闻
12.8-13.9秒——眼睛先动，头不动：视线落到两三个具体的点上，先是竹帘下方的地砖，再沿墙往上。她在核对，不是害怕地乱看
13.9-15.0秒——头这才跟着眼睛转过去，身体最后跟上，她开始向画面右边转身。转得不急，几乎随意，像预计什么也不会找到的人。转到一半停住没有完成。最后留在画面里的不是脸，而是肩背和她面前的黑暗
表演任务（戏全在眼睛里，绝不做表情）
动机：家是唯一能卸下来的地方。障碍：屋里有一股不属于这里的气味。战术：身体按习惯往下走，注意力慢半拍才追上来。演这半拍的延迟，不要演害怕——例行动作照常运转，中途卡住，她才开始读这屋子

第一段：门一开两层光同时进来——门外暖琥珀球灯#E99D25在陶砖上铺楔形，是这段最亮的事件；走廊深处日光灯的冷青绿#ADD794只作第二层、只在最边缘，绝不落到她脸上。门一合上两层光同时消失
第二至五段：唯一光源是柜上的红漆罩台灯——深红灯罩把周围染红，暖琥珀在瓷杯、镜子和一小块黄墙上形成紧凑光池，灯罩周围明显halation，其余沉进带紫近黑，右半边近剪影

2 以摄影机视角为唯一基准：左边木柜与红罩台灯，中央偏左胡桃木单扇门，右边红竹帘遮住的窗——与图1一致，绝不镜像翻转。竹帘后是窗不是房间，入口区只有这一扇窗
3 她跨过门槛完全进屋后才关门
4 切尔西套穿短靴，两只一前一后脱下、绝不同时，左手全程撑门框，两只脚都在画面里，拖鞋不动
5 柜面空着，手袋和钥匙直接放木面上，没有托盘没有热水瓶；她走向柜子的起点永远是门前地垫，方向从画面中间往左，绝不从右边缘入画
6 门洞里的内容直接照用图5——对面的墨绿栏杆与焦外夜城，被门框裁窄且严重焦外；绝不是走廊的纵深透视
7 她的脸全片从未被直接照亮，冷青绿绝不上脸。第五段眼睛先动、头跟着、身体最后
8 构图永不居中；地面素色陶砖不是花砖；没有门链；画面里没有九十年代之后的东西。过期胶片颗粒，halation，变形椭圆焦外，超写实材质，实拍电影质感。

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: OUTSIDE-VIEW
reference_elements.description: this is what is right outside the door when we leave the apartment and look forward

params.prompt:
电影感场景照片，写实风格，50mm胶片剧照。1990年代香港，日落刚过的蓝调时刻——太阳已经落下，天空是深蓝色的暮色，飘着几朵泛蓝灰色调的云，城市轮廓渐渐沉入夜色，无直射阳光，只剩柔和的冷蓝环境光。

关键设定：这是一栋高层住宅大厦第七层的露天外廊（长廊），远高于街面——绝不是汽车旅馆，不是平房，不是临街底层。走廊天花板是上一层楼的楼板，楼上楼下都有同样的外廊层，这是密集的香港"蚁楼"式居民楼。

构图：沿走廊纵深的单点透视。走廊狭窄，宽度只有大约两步——刚好够两个人擦肩而过。

左侧：齐腰高的混凝土矮墙护栏。护栏之外是开阔的空间和深深的落差——从七楼俯瞰蓝调暮色中的城市：远处高低错落、建筑风格各异的住宅楼，部分窗户亮着暖黄的灯，大部分是暗的；下方远处是低层建筑的屋顶，笼罩在青蓝色的暮霭里。一棵高大的树从楼下街道生长上来，树冠顶端刚好够到这一层的护栏边。

右侧：一排公寓入户门，共6–7扇，每扇门都完全不同——深色木门、绿漆铁栅门、褪色的浅绿门、掉漆的棕色门，各有各的把手、贴纸和岁月痕迹。每扇门后是一整套住宅，所以门与门之间隔着很长的空白墙面——从一扇门走到下一扇门需要7–8步，中间偶尔有一扇带百叶的小厨房窗。门绝不能紧挨着，不能像储物柜一样排列。近景只出现两三扇门，其余的门随透视远去。

走廊尽头：清晰可见的开放式楼梯间——真实的混凝土楼梯，带金属扶手，台阶向下通往楼下，回转梯段向上，由一盏小灯照亮。走廊直接通向这个楼梯间，尽头不是死墙，楼梯间是走廊的自然延续，必须一眼看出这是连接各层的公共楼梯。

灯光：天花板下的老式荧光灯管，发出柔和的淡绿色调光——王家卫式的荧光色调，温和而有胶片感，绝不是刺眼的荧光绿、不是霓虹绿、不过饱和。冷绿的灯光在昏暗的蓝调暮色中显得格外突出，与深蓝的天空形成安静的对比。

色调：柔和自然的色彩，青蓝暮色与淡绿灯光的冷色平衡，点缀远处零星的暖黄窗光，胶片质感。走廊空无一人。平视广角镜头，强烈的消失点直指尽头的楼梯间，细腻的胶片颗粒，写实电影剧照。

走廊尽头：清晰可见的开放式楼梯间——真实的混凝土楼梯，带金属扶手，台阶向下通往楼下，回转梯段向上，由一盏小灯照亮。走廊直接���向这个楼梯间，尽头不是死墙，���梯间是走廊的自然延续，必须一眼看出这是连接各层的公共楼梯。

灯光：天花板下的老式荧光灯管，发出柔和的淡绿色调光——王家卫式的荧光色调，温和而有胶片感，绝不是刺眼的荧光绿、不是霓虹绿、不过饱和。冷绿的灯光在昏暗的蓝调暮色中显得格外突出，与深蓝的天空形成安静的对比。

色调：柔和自然的色彩，青蓝暮色与淡绿灯光的冷色平衡，点缀远处零星的暖黄窗光，胶片质感。走廊空无一人。平视广角镜头，强烈的消失点直指尽头的楼梯间，细腻的胶片颗粒，写实电影剧照。

POV from inside the dark entry of her flat, mid-1990s Hong Kong, night — the front door has
just swung open, and the frame is what she sees standing on her doormat: the doorway as a
tall bright rectangle cut into the darkness of the flat, and through it — the gallery and
the city.

Geometry, physically correct: the camera stands about a metre and a half inside the flat at
eye level, square to the doorway. The walnut door leaf is swung fully inward to the left,
its wood grain catching a faint red-amber edge from the table lamp off-frame left; the
brass lever handle glints. The doorway is a true door's proportion — about two metres tall,
eighty centimetres wide — and it frames the view in honest perspective: first the threshold
and the coir doormat at the bottom, then the access-gallery walkway, barely a metre and a
half deep, its worn concrete floor holding a damp sheen and one warm pool of light from a
dome lamp just above the doorway, out of frame; then the gallery balustrade — closely
spaced vertical iron bars with a thick round top rail, painted dark jade-green, the paint
worn, a brown towel draped over the rail slightly right of centre, a string with clothes
pegs sagging between posts; the wrought-iron gate stands open flat against the outside
wall, a sliver of it visible at the doorway's right edge.

Beyond and below the railing, the night city of Hong Kong at a believable distance —
hundreds of metres across the district: dense residential towers rising higher than us,
grids of small warm tungsten windows climbing into the black sky, the rounded crown of one
taller tower lit at its top far left, and one tall vertical neon sign in saturated red
Chinese characters burning among the towers right of centre, its glow doubled faintly in
the humid air; lower rooftops of old blocks in the foreground gap, a few dim rooftop lights.
Fine drizzle drifts past the railing, catching the dome lamp's warmth as tiny sparks; the
city beyond softens in haze. No moon, no stars — only the city's own light.

Exposure is honest: the gallery and city are brighter than the flat, so the interior
surrounding the doorway falls into deep violet-black — the door frame, the yellow wall and
the edge of the cabinet reading only as dark shapes with one red-amber whisper from the
lamp; the beige slippers just visible at the bottom corner of the threshold. The doorway
itself is the picture: warm tungsten walkway, green railing, golden towers, red neon, black
sky — a frame within the frame.

Expired-35mm Wong Kar-wai chemistry: saturated ambers and reds against violet-black,
nothing neutral. Anamorphic 40mm, 16:9: focus on the railing and the towel, the city
melting into oval bokeh — every distant window a soft horizontal-stretched disc, the neon
sign a glowing smear of red; heavy natural grain, halation on the lamp pool and the neon,
milky humid haze. Physically accurate: single-point perspective through the doorway,
correct scale between doorway, walkway, railing and distant towers, true contact shadows,
no impossible reflections, no text readable except the blurred neon characters. No people.
A photograph, not a render. <<<45459fc7-816e-4444-931d-19ddb55d72a4>>> <<<3c8395b4-538e-4294-9182-e6e641c7bb11>>>

reference_elements.name: ENTRANCE
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

params.prompt:
Standing at the threshold of her flat, mid-1990s Hong Kong, night — the view straight out
from her door, no doorway in frame, just what the gallery gives her eyes.

The camera at eye level right at the door line, square to the open side. In the lower
third: the access-gallery walkway itself, barely a metre and a half deep — worn concrete
with a damp sheen, catching one warm amber pool from the dome lamp directly overhead, out
of frame, and the faint colour of the night beyond. Then the balustrade: closely spaced
vertical iron bars with a thick round top rail, painted dark jade-green, the paint worn and
chipped to rust at the joints, beaded with drizzle; a brown towel draped over the rail
slightly right of centre, a sagging string with wooden clothes pegs strung between posts,
raindrops hanging from it.

Beyond the railing, filling the upper two thirds of the frame, the night city at true
distance — hundreds of metres across the district: dense residential towers rising higher
than our third floor, endless grids of small warm tungsten windows climbing into a pure
black sky; far left, the rounded crown of a taller tower lit at its rim; right of centre,
one tall vertical neon sign in saturated red Chinese characters burning between the
towers, its glow bleeding softly into the humid air; below, the darker rooftops of old
walk-ups with a few dim service lights, the gap of a lane hinted in shadow. Fine drizzle
drifts through the frame, each drop a brief warm spark where it crosses the lamp's glow;
the farthest towers dissolve into haze.

Scale and physics, honest: the railing two metres from camera, sharp; the towel's wet
weight believable; the city truly far — its windows small, dense, atmospheric, never
poster-close; the lamp's warm pool on the walkway consistent with a single source
overhead; the drizzle falling only beyond the sheltered walkway edge.

Expired-35mm Wong Kar-wai chemistry: warm golden windows and red neon against violet-black
sky, the green of the railing the single cool note, nothing neutral. Anamorphic 40mm, 16:9:
focus on the railing and the towel, the city melting into oval anamorphic bokeh — every
window a soft horizontally-stretched disc of gold, the neon sign a glowing red smear;
heavy natural film grain, halation on the neon and the lamp pool, milky humid haze. No
people, no doors, no walls in frame. A photograph, not a render. <<<45459fc7-816e-4444-931d-19ddb55d72a4>>> <<<6a2be582-c84d-421c-b54e-838b5e791b63>>>

Edit this image. ONE change only — the CITY on the left becomes CLOSER and BIGGER. Everything else stays pixel-perfect identical: the corridor, the doors with the tiger, the windows, the railing with towels, the dead and glowing lamps, the green stairwell, the dark mood and color grade — no crop, no zoom, no re-lighting.

THE CHANGE: the residential towers beyond the railing move CLOSER to the building — as if the neighboring block stands just across a narrow street. The nearest towers grow LARGE in the frame: their facades fill most of the left side and rise above the top edge of the frame, looming over the corridor; individual windows become clearly readable — some warm-lit with curtains and AC boxes, most dark; the vertical pink-red neon sign now hangs closer and larger, its glow stronger on the haze. Deeper towers stack behind them. The city presses in on the building — tight, dense, claustrophobic Hong Kong, no open sky, no distant panorama on the left side.

Keep the 5th-floor height: the towers rise well above the camera, street glow close below. Same dark oppressive night, same colors, photorealistic, no film grain.

SCENE CONTEXT
Location study of an empty, narrow Hong Kong apartment kitchen at dusk. No people. Four static views, one per wall: the window wall, the fridge wall, the stove wall, the entrance wall. The room simply exists — humming fridge, ticking clock, fading twilight.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<0bff2202-6484-4d8a-9f5e-d0ea62c4cdbe>>> — location reference. Narrow old galley kitchen, dusk: white tiled walls; back wall with a sheer-curtained window, two thin potted plants on the sill, lit residential towers in blue twilight outside, round clock above the window; left wall with double steel sink, worn marble counters, white gas stove and extractor hood, a small warm wall bulb over the stove; right wall with a white single-door fridge covered in magnets and a paper poster, wooden upper cabinets with a warm under-cabinet tube light, a small shelf unit, a counter with glass jars, oranges, a rice cooker and a glowing red glass lamp. Use for geography, materials, atmosphere and light sources. The entrance wall (behind the reference camera) is not shown in the reference: keep it minimal and consistent — same white tiles with wooden trim, a dark open doorway into the unlit corridor, a towel on a hook. Do not invent new rooms, furniture or windows.

FORMAT MODE
Total duration 12 seconds. Controlled four-shot sequence, 3.0s per shot, HARD CUTS at 3.0s, 6.0s and 9.0s. No transitions, no fades. The same kitchen in every shot: same objects, same materials, same dusk light, same clock time. No people, no animals, no moving objects except curtains breathing faintly and the red lamp's steady glow.

OPTICS
Shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lenses. Visible organic Kodak Vision3 500T grain in shadows and midtones, gentle halation around the red lamp, the wall bulb and the bright window, film color response, no digital cleanliness. Anamorphic signature in every frame: vertically stretched oval bokeh on the practicals, and the left and right edges of the frame always dissolve into soft anamorphic blur — sharpness lives in the center of frame.
ALL FOUR SHOTS LENS LOCK = 47°: standard normal anamorphic character, camera 2.5 to 3 meters from each wall, natural human-eye perspective, straight tile lines rectilinear in the sharp zone, no wide-angle stretching, no telephoto compression. Same lens character in all four shots, no drift.

CAMERA
Hard camera rule: the camera NEVER moves closer or further. No dolly-in, no zoom-in, no push-in, no pull-back, no pans, no tilts mid-shot. Each shot is a fixed handheld position: breath-level rise and fall, tiny weight corrections — amplitude so small the composition does not change. Quiet voyeur feel, as if someone stands alone in the empty flat and looks at each wall in turn. Camera height: chest level in all four shots.
Shot A — from the kitchen center facing the BACK WALL: the sheer-curtained window centered, thin plants on the sill, towers glowing outside, clock above.
Shot B — from the kitchen center facing the RIGHT WALL: the fridge with magnets and poster, wooden cabinets with the warm tube light, the counter with jars, oranges, rice cooker and the glowing red lamp.
Shot C — from the kitchen center facing the LEFT WALL: the double steel sink, the gas stove and extractor hood, the small warm bulb burning over the stove, dishes and towels on the shelves.
Shot D — from the kitchen center facing the ENTRANCE WALL: white tiles, the dark open doorway into the unlit corridor, a towel on a hook; deep shadow beyond the doorway.

ACTION TIMING
0.0s to 3.0s — Shot A, back wall: the sheer curtain breathes once, barely, in a draft; twilight windows flicker faintly in the towers outside.
3.0s HARD CUT.
3.0s to 6.0s — Shot B, right wall: the red lamp glows steadily; the fridge hums; nothing moves.
6.0s HARD CUT.
6.0s to 9.0s — Shot C, left wall: the small bulb burns over the stove; a faint water drip glints in the sink.
9.0s HARD CUT.
9.0s to 12.0s — Shot D, entrance wall: the dark doorway stands open into the corridor; stillness.

PHYSICS
Everything is still and grounded: objects rest with real weight, nothing slides, floats or rearranges between shots. The curtain moves only as thin fabric in a weak draft. The drip is a single small glint, not a stream.

LIGHTING
One consistent dusk state across all four shots: cool blue twilight from the window; warm practicals — the wall bulb over the stove, the under-cabinet tube, the red glass lamp — carving small warm pools out of the shadow. Low-key, moody, Hong Kong 90s night palette, Wong Kar-wai mood. Halation on all practicals. Lighting logic stays consistent wall to wall: the window is the only cool source; the warm pools stay where their lamps are.

AUDIO
No dialogue, no music, no subtitles, no voiceover. One continuous ambient bed across all cuts: low fridge hum, soft clock tick, distant muffled city and a far-off tram bell, one tiny water drip in shot C. The room tone does not reset at the cuts.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Zero people in every frame — no figures, hands, shadows of people or reflections of people. The camera never approaches — constant frame size in every shot, breathing handheld only. Same kitchen, same object placement, same dusk light and same clock time in all four shots. Both side edges of frame stay in anamorphic blur in every shot. 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, real visible film grain, halation, anamorphic oval bokeh, grounded physical cinema, stable picture.

params.prompt:
场景背景
深夜，香港1960年代唐楼的单间公寓入口区。年轻女子下班回家：开门进屋、关门、脱靴、走到柜前放下手袋和钥匙。手离开柜面那一刻屋里彻底安静——她察觉到有人来过自己家。她不害怕，只是在核对。全片只有她一人。惊悚感来自静止画面、负空间和声音，绝不来自表演。

激活参考
<<<image_1>>>——场景，已批准的入口正面主镜头。构图、物件位置、材质、色彩、光源100%保留，绝不镜像翻转，绝不新增或移动物件。
<<<image_2>>>——女主。27岁纤细香港华裔女子，深色低发髻；酒红竖条纹立领短袖上衣，做旧低腰喇叭牛仔裤，棕色金属饰腰带，黑色短靴，深色棉袜。面部、发型、服装100%一致。
<<<image_3>>>——道具。红色织锦金线牡丹小手袋，提带极短15-20厘米，进屋前夹在左上臂与身体之间，包顶在腋窝，绝不垂到胸部以下。
<<<image_4>>>——道具。青铜古钥匙配黄铜小老虎挂饰。比例锁定：钥匙长9厘米，挂饰3厘米，永远明显小于钥匙。

场景地图（以摄影机视角为唯一基准，绝不用"进门者的左右"）
摄影机在屋内正对入口墙，五段只看这一面墙；公寓其余部分全在摄影机背后，永不入画。层高3.2米，入口进深1.5米，局促。
画面左边：深色木柜约100厘米高，柜面宽阔而几乎空着——这块空处就是等着放手袋和钥匙的地方；上面只有一只粉彩瓷杯连碟，凉茶，杯沿一枚口红印。柜上方直径40厘米圆镜，镜框下压着一张黑白胶片照片；圆镜左侧一盏红漆罩台灯，实实在在放在柜面上，电线通向插座——入口区唯一的灯。
画面中央偏左：胡桃木贴面入户门，200厘米高、85厘米宽，木纹清晰、边缘磨损；圆润厚重的黄铜执手，下方圆柱锁，上方明装方锁，齐眼高黄铜猫眼，绝无门链。执手与锁在门扇右缘，铰链在左缘，向屋内开。门外走廊侧另有一道锻铁栅门。门前一块椰棕地垫，垫外一双浅米色拖鞋鞋尖朝门并排。

进门规则——逐步编排（硬性，不许改顺序）
第1步：钥匙转动，单片门扇以左缘铰链为轴向屋内划开，自由边由右向左朝摄影机摆过来，短暂遮住画面左边的木柜；门洞右半侧空出来。
第2步：走廊的光涌进来——近处吊灯的暖琥珀在陶砖上铺长楔形；门洞外最深处一层冷青绿城市夜色作第二层。她在这道光里成为逆光的深色身影。
第3步：她跨过门槛，整个人朝摄影机方向走进屋内，走到地垫上站定。此时她已完全在屋里，摄影机与她之间不再隔着门扇。右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋。
第4步：她上半身转回身后，右手扶住门扇右缘，把门扇由左向右推回合上。两层光一起熄灭，只剩柜上的红罩台灯。
第5步：她转回来面朝屋内，站在地垫上。
绝对禁止：站在门外关门；留在门洞里不进屋；隔着门扇做动作；关门时人在门的另一侧；关门后还在走廊里。

脱鞋规则——逐步编排（硬性，两只靴子一前一后，绝不同时）
起始：她站在地垫上，双脚各穿一只黑色短靴，共两只鞋，鞋内深色棉袜。双手全程不碰鞋：右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋，只用两只脚完成。
第1步：重心移到右脚，用右脚尖踩住左靴后跟外沿向下压住。
第2步：左脚向上向后抽出，左靴脱离，空着倒在地砖上，不再移动。
第3步：短暂停顿，重心换到穿袜的左脚，身体轻微摇晃一下站稳。
第4步：用穿袜的左脚尖踩住右靴后跟外沿向下压住。
第5步：右脚向上向后抽出，右靴脱离，落在第一只旁，不再移动。
第6步：她双脚穿袜站在地垫上，两只空靴并排躺着。拖鞋全程原样不动，这一段不去穿。
物理：门扇有重量与铰链阻力，划开与推回匀速、到位不回弹；跨门槛有真实重心转移；靴子落地有重量之后不再移动；手袋放下时织锦软塌一下；钥匙落到木面是一声轻而硬的响。手不悬浮，道具不失重。
绝对禁止：两脚同时脱鞋；用手碰鞋；出现第三只鞋或多余的脚；鞋子变形、拉长、融化；脚穿过鞋面；鞋子自己脱落或移动；脱下来又穿回去。

她的路线（硬性）
门外→跨门槛进屋→站到地垫上→在身后关门→先后脱两只短靴→穿袜从地垫向画面左边走两步到柜前→转身面朝柜子→先放红手袋到空柜面，再把钥匙放在手袋旁的木面上→直起身→开始向画面右边转身。起点永远是门前的地垫。
绝对禁止：从画面右边缘入画；从画面右侧或深处走向柜子；在柜子右边以外的地方凭空出现；把钥匙放进任何托盘或容器。

首帧与拍摄模式
第一帧门扇已划开一道缝，走廊暖光已落在陶砖上，<<<image_2>>>已在门洞右半侧正要跨门槛——没有空镜开场，没有延迟出场。总时长15秒，五段式：3.0、6.0、8.5、10.0秒各一次硬切。实时速度，无其他剪切或转场。

静止机位——最高优先级
摄影机全程完全静止，五段都是锁死的固定机位：不推近、不拉远、不变焦、不摇、不移、不跟随、不手持晃动、不做任何呼吸感浮动。每段是一个钉死的画框，只有她在画框里移动，段内景别绝对恒定。
段间机位只沿正对入口墙的方向改变距离和高度，永远正对这面墙，绝不换角度、绝不越轴、绝不出现图1里看不见的墙面。换视角时是她转身，摄影机绝不绕她走。

光学镜头
全片统一一颗40mm变形宽银幕镜头，景别只靠机位远近，绝不焦段漂移。大光圈全开、景深极浅——只有一个平面锐利，前后一切化开；焦外光斑竖椭圆，画面左右边缘anamorphic虚化，台灯高光有竖向拖影。35mm过期胶片有机颗粒，红帘与台灯周围明显halation，湿润空气感。
超写实硬性：真实人类皮肤——毛孔、细小瑕疵、哑光油光、真实唇纹；材质完全解析——木门漆面与木纹、瓷杯釉面与口红印、织锦金线、发髻碎发、陶砖的灰与砖缝。绝不允许塑料皮肤、蜡像脸、CG光泽、磨皮、数字干净感、糊感。

五段机位、构图与动作（构图永不居中，主体在三分线上；每段机位锁死不动）
第一段 全景——她开门进屋。机位在屋内离墙约2.5米，高110厘米，轻微仰角，图1完整构图入画。

第二段 特写——她脱鞋。机位在地面以上30厘米，紧贴地垫，正对入口墙。画面里只有地垫、她膝盖以下的小腿、两只黑色短靴、焦外的拖鞋和门扇下缘。焦点锁在正脱的那只靴子上。
3.0-3.3秒——她站在地垫上，重心移到右脚。
3.3-4.4秒——右脚尖压住左靴后跟，左脚抽出，左靴倒在地砖上。
4.4-4.7秒——重心换到穿袜的左脚，身体轻微摇晃一下站稳。
4.7-5.8秒——左脚尖压住右靴后跟，右脚抽出，右靴落在第一只旁。
5.8-6.0秒——两只空靴并排躺着，她双脚穿袜站定。
第三段 全景——她走向柜子。机位比第一段更近，高120厘米，正对入口墙，框住门扇与画面左边的木柜、圆镜、台灯。

第四段 特写——她放下手袋和钥匙。机位推到柜前，仍正对入口墙，高95厘米，与柜面齐平的微距。瓷杯在前景完全焦外。
8.5-9.4秒——她先把红织锦手袋放到空着的木柜面上，织锦在灯下泛起金线。
9.4-10.0秒——她的手很随意地把钥匙放在手袋旁的木面上，一声轻响，手收回出画，钥匙静止。日常动作，不停顿、不迟疑、不做戏。
第五段 全景——她察觉屋里有别人。机位后撤、高130厘米，正对入口墙，全段一动不动。她在画面左侧三分之一站在柜边，右侧是竹帘那面深红的负空间与黑。焦点锁定头肩，绝不移焦。
10.0-11.0秒——她直起身，手离开柜面，肩膀松下来，轻轻吐一口气。回家的动作做完了。
11.0-11.9秒——她没有动，但松下来的肩膀停住了、没有继续落下去；呼吸变轻，不是屏住只是变浅。重心悄悄从一只脚挪成两脚均分——从随便站着变成站稳了。

13.9-15.0秒——头这才跟着眼睛转过去，身体最后跟上，她开始向画面右边转身。转得不急，几乎随意，像一个预计什么也不会找到的人。转到一半停住，没有完成。最后留在画面里的不是脸，而是肩背和她面前的黑暗。

表演任务（戏全在眼睛里，绝不做表情）
动机：家是唯一能卸下来的地方。目标：完成回家的例行动作。障碍：屋里有一股不属于这里的气味。战术：身体按习惯往下走，注意力慢半拍才追上来。演这半拍的延迟，不要演害怕——例行动作照常运转，中途卡住，然后她才开始读这屋子。
第五段：她怀疑的不是有危险，而是有人来过我家。战术：核对，像检查一件放错位置的东西。怀疑是问句不是警报。变化发生在静止的质地里，不在脸上——肩膀落下就不再动，呼吸变浅，重心站匀。这就是全部信号，脸上几乎什么也不做。
顺序硬性：眼睛先动，头跟着，身体最后。这个顺序就是真实感本身，绝不允许头先动或整个人一起转。
安全线：目光始终落在屋里真实的点上，静止中眼睛依然活着，绝不呆滞玻璃化。
绝对禁止：瞪大眼睛、倒抽气、屏息的夸张停顿、耸肩、皱眉、猛地扭头、惊悚片表情、对着镜头表演。

灯光——电影感硬性规定
深夜低照度，光压得很暗很柔，但必须有方向、明暗和层次——绝不允许平光。
第一段：门一开两层光同时进来——近处走廊吊灯的暖琥珀#E99D25在陶砖上铺楔形，是这段最亮的事件；门洞外最远处一层冷青绿#ADD794的城市夜色只作第二层、只在最深处，绝不落到她的脸和皮肤上。门一合上两层光同时消失。
第二至五段：唯一光源是柜上的红漆罩台灯——深红灯罩把周围染红，暖琥珀在瓷杯、镜子和一小块黄墙上形成紧凑光池，灯罩周围明显halation，其余沉进带紫近黑，入口右半边接近纯剪影。
硬性：台灯每一段都物理地在她头部后方或侧后方，绝不在正前方。她的脸从头到尾没有被直接照亮——只靠溢光、黄墙反弹和下颌与颧骨上的一道边缘光成形，正面始终在柔和半影里（4:1）。绝不允许照亮全脸的平光、正面柔光、没有阴影的脸。
四色和弦：暖琥珀#E99D25为主，漆红#BA0101在竹帘与灯罩上作最响重音，青玉绿#ADD794只在最深处作冷对位、绝不上脸，其余压进#040011。色彩是整幅画面的浸染不是点缀——白的偏金，灰的偏青玉，阴影压到近黑不发灰。

对白与声音
全片无台词、无人声、无旁白、无字幕、无配乐。

正向锁定
五段全是完全静止的锁死机位，绝不推拉变焦摇移，绝不手持晃动；同一颗40mm变形镜头、大光圈、极浅景深，机位永远正对入口墙。以摄影机视角为唯一基准：画面左边木柜与红罩台灯，中央偏左胡桃木单扇门，画面右边红竹帘遮住的窗——与图1完全一致，绝不镜像翻转。竹帘后面是窗不是房间，完全不透光；入口区只有这一扇窗。她跨过门槛进屋之后才关门。两只靴子一前一后脱下，绝不同时，全程不用手；拖鞋原样不动。柜面空着，手袋和钥匙直接放在木面上，没有托盘、没有热水瓶。开门时暖琥珀在近处、冷青绿只在最深处，绝不上脸。她的脸全片从未被直接照亮。第五段眼睛先动、头跟着、身体最后。构图永不居中。地面素色陶砖不是花砖，没有门链。过期胶片颗粒，halation，变形椭圆焦外，超写实材质，实拍电影质感。

场景背景
深夜，香港1960年代唐楼的单间公寓入口区。年轻女子下班回家：开门进屋、关门、脱靴、走到柜前放下手袋和钥匙。手离开柜面那一刻屋里彻底安静——她察觉到有人来过自己家。她不害怕，只是在核对。全片只有她一人。惊悚感来自静止画面、负空间和声音，绝不来自表演。

进门规则——逐步编排（硬性，不许改顺序）
第1步：钥匙转动，单片门扇以左缘铰链为轴向屋内划开，自由边由右向左朝摄影机摆过来，短暂遮住画面左边的木柜；门洞右半侧空出来。
第2步：走廊的光涌进来——近处吊灯的暖琥珀在陶砖上铺长楔形；门洞外最深处一层冷青绿城市夜色作第二层。她在这道光里成为逆光的深色身影。
第3步：她跨过门槛，整个人朝摄影机方向走进屋内，走到地垫上站定。此时她已完全在屋里，摄影机与她之间不再隔着门扇。右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋。
第4步：她上半身转回身后，右手扶住门扇右缘，把门扇由左向右推回合上。两层光一起熄灭，只剩柜上的红罩台灯。
第5步：她转回来面朝屋内，站在地垫上。
绝对禁止：站在门外关门；留在门洞里不进屋；隔着门扇做动作；关门时人在门的另一侧；关门后还在走廊里。

脱鞋规则——逐步编排（硬性，两只靴子一前一后，绝不同时）
起始：她站在地垫上，双脚各穿一只黑色短靴，共两只鞋，鞋内深色棉袜。双手全程不碰鞋：右手握钥匙，左臂夹手袋，只用两只脚完成。
第1步：重心移到右脚，用右脚尖踩住左靴后跟外沿向下压住。
第2步：左脚向上向后抽出，左靴脱离，空着倒在地砖上，不再移动。
第3步：短暂停顿，重心换到穿袜的左脚，身体轻微摇晃一下站稳。
第4步：用穿袜的左脚尖踩住右靴后跟外沿向下压住。
第5步：右脚向上向后抽出，右靴脱离，落在第一只旁，不再移动。
第6步：她双脚穿袜站在地垫上，两只空靴并排躺着。拖鞋全程原样不动，这一段不去穿。
物理：门扇有重量与铰链阻力，划开与推回匀速、到位不回弹；跨门槛有真实重心转移；靴子落地有重量之后不再移动；手袋放下时织锦软塌一下；钥匙落到木面是一声轻而硬的响。手不悬浮，道具不失重。
绝对禁止：两脚同时脱鞋；用手碰鞋；出现第三只鞋或多余的脚；鞋子变形、拉长、融化；脚穿过鞋面；鞋子自己脱落或移动；脱下来又穿回去。

她的路线（硬性）
门外→跨门槛进屋→站到地垫上→在身后关门→先后脱两只短靴→穿袜从地垫向画面左边走两步到柜前→转身面朝柜子→先放红手袋到空柜面，再把钥匙放在手袋旁的木面上→直起身→开始向画面右边转身。起点永远是门前的地垫。
绝对禁止：从画面右边缘入画；从画面右侧或深处走向柜子；在柜子右边以外的地方凭空出现；把钥匙放进任何托盘或容器。

首帧与拍摄模式
第一帧门扇已划开一道缝，走廊暖光已落在陶砖上，<<<image_2>>>已在门洞右半侧正要跨门槛——没有空镜开场，没有延迟出场。总时长15秒，五段式：3.0、6.0、8.5、10.0秒各一次硬切。实时速度，无其他剪切或转场。

静止机位——最高优先级
摄影机全程完全静止，五段都是锁死的固定机位：不推近、不拉远、不变焦、不摇、不移、不跟随、不手持晃动、不做任何呼吸感浮动。每段是一个钉死的画框，只有她在画框里移动，段内景别绝对恒定。
段间机位只沿正对入口墙的方向改变距离和高度，永远正对这面墙，绝不换角度、绝不越轴、绝不出现图1里看不见的墙面。换视角时是她转身，摄影机绝不绕她走。

光学镜头
全片统一一颗40mm变形宽银幕镜头，景别只靠机位远近，绝不焦段漂移。大光圈全开、景深极浅——只有一个平面锐利，前后一切化开；焦外光斑竖椭圆，画面左右边缘anamorphic虚化，台灯高光有竖向拖影。35mm过期胶片有机颗粒，红帘与台灯周围明显halation，湿润空气感。
超写实硬性：真实人类皮肤——毛孔、细小瑕疵、哑光油光、真实唇纹；材质完全解析——木门漆面与木纹、瓷杯釉面与口红印、织锦金线、发髻碎发、陶砖的灰与砖缝。绝不允许塑料皮肤、蜡像脸、CG光泽、磨皮、数字干净感、糊感。

五段机位、构图与动作（构图永不居中，主体在三分线上；每段机位锁死不动）
第一段 全景——她开门进屋。机位在屋内离墙约2.5米，高110厘米，轻微仰角，图1完整构图入画。
0.0-1.0秒——钥匙转动，单片门扇由右向左向内划开，走廊暖琥珀在陶砖上铺出长楔形，更远处一层冷青绿城市夜色。
1.0-2.0秒——她跨过门槛，逆光的深色身影朝摄影机方向走进屋里，站到画面中央偏右的地垫上；小小的身形只占高门洞的下半部。
2.0-3.0秒——她上半身转向身后，右手把门扇由左向右推回合上；两层光一起熄灭，只剩红罩台灯；她转回来面朝屋内。
第二段 特写——她脱鞋。机位在地面以上30厘米，紧贴地垫，正对入口墙。画面里只有地垫、她膝盖以下的小腿、两只黑色短靴、焦外的拖鞋和门扇下缘。焦点锁在正脱的那只靴子上。
3.0-3.3秒——她站在地垫上，重心移到右脚。
3.3-4.4秒——右脚尖压住左靴后跟，左脚抽出，左靴倒在地砖上。
4.4-4.7秒——重心换到穿袜的左脚，身体轻微摇晃一下站稳。
4.7-5.8秒——左脚尖压住右靴后跟，右脚抽出，右靴落在第一只旁。
5.8-6.0秒——两只空靴并排躺着，她双脚穿袜站定。
第三段 全景——她走向柜子。机位比第一段更近，高120厘米，正对入口墙，框住门扇与画面左边的木柜、圆镜、台灯。
6.0-8.5秒——她从画面中央的地垫出发，穿袜向画面左边走两步到柜前，转回来面朝柜子，背部朝摄影机呈四分之三角，台灯在她头部后方，右手伸向空柜面。运动方向从中间往左，绝不从画面右边入画。
第四段 特写——她放下手袋和钥匙。机位推到柜前，仍正对入口墙，高95厘米，与柜面齐平的微距。瓷杯在前景完全焦外。
8.5-9.4秒——她先把红织锦手袋放到空着的木柜面上，织锦在灯下泛起金线。
9.4-10.0秒——她的手很随意地把钥匙放在手袋旁的木面上，一声轻响，手收回出画，钥匙静止。日常动作，不停顿、不迟疑、不做戏。
第五段 全景——她察觉屋里有别人。机位后撤、高130厘米，正对入口墙，全段一动不动。她在画面左侧三分之一站在柜边，右侧是竹帘那面深红的负空间与黑。焦点锁定头肩，绝不移焦。
10.0-11.0秒——她直起身，手离开柜面，肩膀松下来，轻轻吐一口气。回家的动作做完了。
11.0-11.9秒——她没有动，但松下来的肩膀停住了、没有继续落下去；呼吸变轻，不是屏住只是变浅。重心悄悄从一只脚挪成两脚均分——从随便站着变成站稳了。
11.9-12.8秒——她微微抬起下巴，用鼻子短短吸一口气。这是气味迟到一拍才被认出来时不由自主的一下，不是表演性嗅闻。眉毛不动。
12.8-13.9秒——眼睛先动，头不动：视线落到两三个具体的点上，先是竹帘下方的地砖，再沿墙面往上。她在核对，不是害怕地乱看。
13.9-15.0秒——头这才跟着眼睛转过去，身体最后跟上，她开始向画面右边转身。转得不急，几乎随意，像一个预计什么也不会找到的人。转到一半停住，没有完成。最后留在画面里的不是脸，而是肩背和她面前的黑暗。

表演任务（戏全在眼睛里，绝不做表情）
动机：家是唯一能卸下来的地方。目标：完成回家的例行动作。障碍：屋里有一股不属于这里的气味。战术：身体按习惯往下走，注意力慢半拍才追上来。演这半拍的延迟，不要演害怕——例行动作照常运转，中途卡住，然后她才开始读这屋子。
第五段：她怀疑的不是有危险，而是有人来过我家。战术：核对，像检查一件放错位置的东西。怀疑是问句不是警报。变化发生在静止的质地里，不在脸上——肩膀落下就不再动，呼吸变浅，重心站匀。这就是全部信号，脸上几乎什么也不做。
顺序硬性：眼睛先动，头跟着，身体最后。这个顺序就是真实感本身，绝不允许头先动或整个人一起转。
安全线：目光始终落在屋里真实的点上，静止中眼睛依然活着，绝不呆滞玻璃化。
绝对禁止：瞪大眼睛、倒抽气、屏息的夸张停顿、耸肩、皱眉、猛地扭头、惊悚片表情、对着镜头表演。

灯光——电影感硬性规定
深夜低照度，光压得很暗很柔，但必须有方向、明暗和层次——绝不允许平光。
第一段：门一开两层光同时进来——近处走廊吊灯的暖琥珀#E99D25在陶砖上铺楔形，是这段最亮的事件；门洞外最远处一层冷青绿#ADD794的城市夜色只作第二层、只在最深处，绝不落到她的脸和皮肤上。门一合上两层光同时消失。
第二至五段：唯一光源是柜上的红漆罩台灯——深红灯罩把周围染红，暖琥珀在瓷杯、镜子和一小块黄墙上形成紧凑光池，灯罩周围明显halation，其余沉进带紫近黑，入口右半边接近纯剪影。
硬性：台灯每一段都物理地在她头部后方或侧后方，绝不在正前方。她的脸从头到尾没有被直接照亮——只靠溢光、黄墙反弹和下颌与颧骨上的一道边缘光成形，正面始终在柔和半影里（4:1）。绝不允许照亮全脸的平光、正面柔光、没有阴影的脸。
四色和弦：暖琥珀#E99D25为主，漆红#BA0101在竹帘与灯罩上作最响重音，青玉绿#ADD794只在最深处作冷对位、绝不上脸，其余压进#040011。色彩是整幅画面的浸染不是点缀——白的偏金，灰的偏青玉，阴影压到近黑不发灰。

对白与声音
全片无台词、无人声、无旁白、无字幕、无配乐。
钥匙在旧锁里转动的金属声，木门轴干涩的吱呀声。门一开走廊声音涌入：空调外机嗡鸣、隔壁粤语电视声、一滴水落下；门合上之后被干净切断。屋内：两只靴子先后落地的两声、袜底走在陶砖上的轻响、手袋落到木面的闷响、钥匙碰木面的轻响、远处风扇低鸣、她放轻的呼吸。第五段只剩风扇、变浅的呼吸和一次极轻的吸气。狭小干燥的室内声学。

正向锁定
五段全是完全静止的锁死机位，绝不推拉变焦摇移，绝不手持晃动；同一颗40mm变形镜头、大光圈、极浅景深，机位永远正对入口墙。以摄影机视角为唯一基准：画面左边木柜与红罩台灯，中央偏左胡桃木单扇门，画面右边红竹帘遮住的窗——与图1完全一致，绝不镜像翻转。竹帘后面是窗不是房间，完全不透光；入口区只有这一扇窗。她跨过门槛进屋之后才关门。两只靴子一前一后脱下，绝不同时，全程不用手；拖鞋原样不动。柜面空着，手袋和钥匙直接放在木面上，没有托盘、没有热水瓶。开门时暖琥珀在近处、冷青绿只在最深处，绝不上脸。她的脸全片从未被直接照亮。第五段眼睛先动、头跟着、身体最后。构图永不居中。地面素色陶砖不是花砖，没有门链。过期胶片颗粒，halation，变形椭圆焦外，超写实材质，实拍电影质感。

香港九十年代中期深夜，唐楼外廊。他刚被她从那扇虎门里赶出来——正面正对着这扇门站着，背抵外廊铁栏杆，身后是夜城万家灯火。一束芍药从门里迎面飞出砸到他胸口，虎门当着他的面砰然关上。他愣着，胸口堵着火：又被拒绝了。他低头翻花，找到那枝折断的，一把拔出来，带着火气甩在湿漉漉的水泥地上。全片只有他一人

三段
第一段 中景侧拍（0-3.0秒）。机位沿外廊纵深拍，他以完整侧面立在画面中央：画面右侧是那扇虎门，左侧是墨绿铁栏杆和焦外夜城——他面朝右侧的门、背抵左侧的栏杆，站在门前一步半，刚被从这扇门里推出来。敞开的门洞透出屋里的深红光，红光落在他前襟和门前地面上。花束从右侧门里飞出，侧向砸在他胸口——他一抖手笨拙按住，花瓣散落；同一瞬虎门在他面前正常地砰然关上：门扇绕铰链摆回门框，严丝合缝，那片红光被门板遮没。他的侧脸绷着，下颌咬紧，怒意压在牙关里
第二段 特写（3.0-5.0秒）。机位推近他手上，高120厘米，焦点锁在花束。他烦躁地翻了两下，翻到图4那枝断花——耷拉的花头一眼认得出。两根手指掐住断茎，利落一把拔出来，快、准、带火气，其余完好的花没被弄乱。指间就是图4那朵断花，花头晃着
第三段 低角度（5.0-7.0秒）——王家卫式。机位贴着湿水泥地面，高15厘米，沿外廊纵深拍：前景是雨后湿亮的水泥地，泛着头顶球灯拉长的反光；中景是他的腿和攥着花束垂在身侧的手，纵深里球灯排成一串焦外光球。他手腕一甩——断花摔在前景的湿水泥上，弹了半下，停住。最后一秒特写收在这朵躺在湿地上的断花：蔫皱的花瓣贴着湿水泥，折断的茎，锐利清晰；他的腿在焦外没动
表演任务
他的脸是愤怒，不是悲伤。被拒绝伤到的是他的自尊：一个自恋、自视甚高的男人当面吃了闭门羹——恼火、不服、觉得受了冒犯，眼神里是「她竟然敢」而不是「我好难过」。下颌咬紧，鼻息重，嘴角向下绷。摘断花、甩断花都带着迁怒的利落。但火只到指尖为止，他不是暴徒。绝对禁止：任何悲伤或委屈的神情、湿眼眶、垂头哭丧；也绝不吼叫、踢打、摔整束花、狰狞夸张、看镜头
声音
无台词无配乐。花束砸在他胸口的闷响、花瓣落地、虎门砰然一声和门框震颤、断茎被摘断的脆响、断花摔在湿水泥上极轻的一声、他重了一拍的鼻息、夜风、远处空调外机与城市。狭长外廊的夜声学
