— REFERENCE DEFINITIONS —
<<<7860dd11-06df-4111-b144-346ef9babfb9>>>: 29岁纤细东亚女子，深色低发髻、斜分刘海，酒红条纹立领短袖上衣——外貌100%按此参考，必须与参考图是同一个人；全程干净清爽：不出汗、头发不湿、脸上没有水光，下巴与嘴角干净干燥、绝无任何液滴。Character appearance only. Reference.
<<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>: 厨房光照基准——本镜头中它只是她身后彻底失焦的背景：左侧灶台的暖黄橙光斑、纵深窗口的冷绿光斑、右上红罩台灯的一粒红点。Location light only, all defocused. Reference.
— TECHNICAL BLOCK —
Ultra filmic, Wong Kar-wai mood, pristine 35mm Kodak 500T scan — fine organic grain, halation, rich organic color, real skin texture with visible pores, RAZOR-SHARP focus on her face — no plastic skin, NO CGI, NON-IP; no compression softness, no smearing, no low-res mush. LENS: 300mm anamorphic telephoto, aperture wide open — extreme background compression, paper-thin depth of field: ONLY her face in focus; the foreground bead strands become soft vertical blur bands at the frame edges, the kitchen behind her melts into huge oval bokeh washes. 21:9. 5s. ONE continuous shot, camera FIXED — breathing handheld drift only: NO push-in, NO pull-out, NO zoom, NO tracking, NO rack focus. She NEVER looks into the lens. Her lips stay relaxed, closed, STILL — no biting, no pressing, no speaking; chin clean and DRY. Diegetic sound only.
— PROMPT —
单镜头5秒，300mm长焦她的面部超大特写：机位在珠帘门洞处、朝厨房纵深拍；她站在约两米深处、面对镜头方向，脸占据画面中央偏左——头微微低着、下颌收着，眼睛从眉骨下方抬起、目光明显偏离镜头——落在画框外侧下方、刚被撞开的珠帘方向，绝不看镜头、绝不与观众对视；一道红光（红罩台灯与珠帘的反红）从右上方斜切过她的发顶、额角与颧骨，另一侧脸沉在偏冷的暗调里；长焦把纵深压扁：画框两侧几道竖向的柔和虚影（失焦的珠帘串）、背景里左侧暖黄与冷绿的巨大光斑、右上一粒红色光点——全部深度失焦，只有她的脸锐利、毛孔可见。男人刚刚穿帘飞出去——全部发生在画外、开拍前。整个镜头只演一件事：她的情绪转变。(0:00–0:01) 开场状态：目光钉死珠帘方向，眼神还带着出手后的余劲——冷、狠、稳；胸口随刚发力后的呼吸起伏一次；画框边缘的珠帘虚影快速掠过一两下、哗啦一阵后自然荡回。(0:01–0:02) 珠帘声稀成零星轻响；她呼吸转入鼻腔，眼睛几乎不眨。(0:02) 反应正落在这一秒：她认出了刚才那个人是谁——眼睛微微睁大一点点（幅度极小，绝不夸张、绝不瞪眼），眉头松开，凶狠从眼神里退掉、变成怔住的空白；就这一下，别的什么都不动。(0:02–0:05) 她保持这个怔住的状态：呼吸放缓，只有睫毛一次极轻的颤动，珠帘虚影彻底静下来——嘴唇全程放松闭合、纹丝不动：绝不咬唇、绝不抿嘴、绝不张嘴；画面在她目光仍怔在原处的瞬间戛然结束。全片只有她一个人；机位与焦点绝不动——焦点从头到尾钉在她脸上；她的目光全程绝不落进镜头、绝无一帧与镜头对视；没有台词、没有任何嘴部动作；不微笑、不流泪、不皱鼻；面部与下巴始终干净干燥、绝无液滴或水光；红光斜切一侧、其余偏冷偏暗，绝不提亮、绝无平光；构图偏心不居中；绝无推近拉远变焦。
SOUND: Loud diegetic 90s Hong Kong ballad from the boombox (in-scene, off to the side) — under it: bead strands clattering once at the top and quickly decaying to sparse soft clicks, one heavy breath settling into slow nose-breathing, faint night breeze. NO dialogue, NO lip movement, no subtitles. No music score besides the diegetic song.

场景背景
深夜，老公寓。厨房里，闯入的男人从背后靠近年轻女子——她抓住他的手臂，一记干净利落的摔技把他摔向门口：他的身体穿破红色珠帘，重重摔在走廊地板上。他仰面躺着喘息，抬眼看见走廊墙上满搁板的武术奖杯和成排的奖牌。她缓缓拨开珠帘走出来，低头看着他，用粤语问：你在这里做什么，Li？

激活参考
<<<7860dd11-06df-4111-b144-346ef9babfb9>>>——女主参考。29岁纤细东亚女子，深色低发髻，斜分刘海；酒红条纹立领短袖上衣，做旧低腰喇叭牛仔裤，棕色金属饰腰带，黑色小跟鞋。面部、发型、服装100%与参考一致。声音：轻柔低沉的香港粤语。
<<<16d1abed-1999-48bd-98db-42cd28fb48f2>>>#1——男主参考。30多岁东亚男性，深色短发，宽肩，黑色皮机车夹克、斑马纹衬衫、黑色长裤。面部、发型、服装100%与参考一致。
<<<929e5abd-62fe-46d3-afb6-ebe5392a2e83>>>——场景参考（仅第一段）。深夜旧厨房：入口挂整面红色珠帘；左墙油烟机（橙色灯亮着）、燃气灶、平底锅、水槽；后墙蕾丝帘推拉窗，窗台小红花瓶，窗外冷绿光；窗右侧白色双门冰箱；右侧台面银灰收录机、红罩台灯。场景保持原样，仅用于空间、材质、氛围与光源，不用于构图。
<<<1ae9138c-1579-4036-9334-104fc7ecbde7>>>——场景参考（第二至五段）。深夜公寓走廊：左侧是通往厨房的门洞，挂整面红色珠帘，珠帘后透出厨房的红光；走廊右墙一层木搁板，摆一排金色武术奖杯（顶端格斗小人），搁板下挂几十枚彩色绶带奖牌；墙面旧黄斑驳，地面旧瓷砖。场景保持原样，仅用于空间、材质、氛围与光源，不用于构图。

场景地图
两个空间由同一个挂红色珠帘的门洞连接：门洞的厨房一侧=<<<929e5abd-62fe-46d3-afb6-ebe5392a2e83>>>的入口；门洞的走廊一侧=<<<1ae9138c-1579-4036-9334-104fc7ecbde7>>>的左侧门洞。奖杯搁板在走廊东墙、门洞右侧，高度在头部以上，奖牌垂在搁板下。
第一段（厨房内）：摄影机在厨房深处窗户一侧，朝入口珠帘方向拍摄——珠帘门洞在画面纵深。他从背后靠近她；她在画面中偏右，他在她与珠帘之间。摔技把他朝珠帘方向摔出。
第二至五段（走廊）：他穿破珠帘落在走廊地板中央，仰面，头朝奖杯墙一侧，脚朝门洞；摔倒后全程留在地板上，不起身。她随后穿过珠帘站到门洞处。
比例锁定：两人是普通成年人；他比她高半头，但此刻躺在地上。

首帧与空间调度
第一帧即有动作：厨房内，他已经从背后贴近她、手正伸向她的脸——她的手已经抓住他的手腕。没有空镜开场，没有静止铺垫。全片只有这两个人。

拍摄模式
总时长15秒。受控五段式序列：4.0秒动作匹配剪辑（MATCH CUT ON ACTION），6.0秒硬切，9.5秒硬切，10.5秒硬切。实时速度（摔技高潮半秒除外），无其他剪切或转场。
动作匹配剪辑规则：第一段结尾他的身体撞进珠帘的瞬间=第二段开头他从珠帘另一面穿出的瞬间——同一个连续动作从两个空间接力完成，动作不重复、不跳帧。

光学镜头
全片统一一颗镜头：50mm等效、47°对角视场的标准变形宽银幕镜头——五段同一镜头特性，景别差异只靠机位物理远近。变形特征每一帧：焦外光斑竖椭圆形，画面左右边缘溶入柔和anamorphic涂抹虚化。段内与段间不允许焦段漂移。
35毫米胶片：明显的Kodak Vision3 500T有机颗粒，红珠帘、红灯、橙色灶台光、冷绿窗光带光晕（halation），胶片色彩响应。
皮肤硬性规定：真实人类皮肤——毛孔、细小瑕疵、自然哑光油光；绝不允许塑料皮肤、蜡像脸、CG光泽、磨皮、数字干净感。

手持摄影——最高优先级（每一段都是手持）
全部五段、每一帧都是手持肩扛拍摄。可见结果：取景框永远不完全静止——呼吸般起伏、细小漂移、摔技瞬间一次明显的重心晃动后再稳住。特写和插入镜头同样浮动。绝不是三脚架死静，绝不是稳定器顺滑，不是数字抖动。
同样硬性：绝不推近、拉远、变焦——每段景别恒定。
风格：王家卫式——手持的亲密与不安、浓烈红绿撞色、光晕、夜的潮湿质感；第一段摔技高潮允许半秒轻微慢快门运动拖影（motion smear），仅此半秒。

摄影机与构图（构图永不居中）
第一段【手持·厨房】全景：机位在厨房深处窗边、胸部高度，朝珠帘门洞方向；两人在画面中偏右三分之二区域扭斗，珠帘门洞在纵深偏左；橙色灶台光从左侧打在两人身上，红珠帘在纵深发红光。地平线轻微倾斜约3度。
第二段【手持·走廊】全景：机位在走廊、胸部高度，朝珠帘门洞——门洞在画面左侧三分之一，奖杯搁板边缘挂在右上角前景焦外；他穿破珠帘朝镜头方向飞出，落在画面下半部地板上。
第三段【手持·走廊】特写：机位贴近地板（离地约30厘米）；他仰面，面部在画面左侧三分之一；视线缓缓移向画面右上——奖杯搁板方向；搁板与奖牌在右上角焦外发金色微光。
第四段【手持·走廊】插入（1秒）：奖杯搁板特写——金色奖杯的格斗小人、层叠的奖牌绶带充满画面，略偏右构图；焦点固定，只有手持浮动。
第五段【手持·走廊】低角度：机位在他倒地位置旁、离地约40厘米，仰拍门洞——珠帘余摆，红珠反光；她拨开珠串缓缓走出，几乎全身入画，位于画面右侧三分之一，红色厨房光在她身后勾轮廓；她在他上方停住，低头看向镜头下方。前景左下是他失焦的肩膀轮廓作遮挡。

动作时间轴
0.0-1.2秒——【手持·厨房】他从背后贴近她，手伸向她的眼睛——她的手已扣住他的手腕，身体开始转动。
1.2-2.8秒——摔技高潮：她借他的重量转胯发力，干净的过肩摔——他双脚离地、身体划过画面（此半秒允许轻微运动拖影），飞向珠帘门洞。
2.8-4.0秒——他的身体撞进珠帘：珠串炸开、哗啦作响——在他即将穿过门洞的瞬间——
4.0秒 动作匹配剪辑。
4.0-6.0秒——【手持·走廊】同一动作从走廊一侧接力：他穿破珠帘朝镜头飞出，重重摔在走廊地板上，背部先着地，一声闷响；珠串四散摆动；珠帘后的红光里留着她的身影。
6.0秒 硬切。
6.0-7.2秒——【手持·地面特写】他躺着喘息，胸口起伏，疼得闭了一下眼。
7.2-9.5秒——他的目光从天花板缓缓移向右上方——停住：满搁板的奖杯、成排的奖牌进入视野；表情从疼痛变成一点点安静下来的明白——他重新认识了刚才摔他的人。
9.5秒 硬切。
9.5-10.5秒——【手持·插入】奖杯与奖牌充满画面，一秒。
10.5秒 硬切。
10.5-12.5秒——【手持·低角度】珠帘余摆中，她伸手拨开珠串，缓缓地、不紧不慢地穿过门洞走出——珠串沿她的肩滑开、轻响；她在他上方停住，低头看他。
12.5-14.5秒——她看着他，说出台词（见对白）——平静、低、带一点无奈和责备，不喊、不怒。
14.5-15.0秒——沉默；珠帘最后一颗珠子静止；他在画面下缘喘息；画面结束。

表演任务（两人都完全投入战术，戏在眼睛里）
场景事件：这间公寓说出了真相——他的闯入暴露了，她的过去也暴露了（满墙冠军奖牌）。
她——场景方向：把家夺回来。动机：这是她的领地。目标：解除威胁、弄清这个人为什么在这。战术：摔技之后不追击——她已经赢了；穿珠帘时刻意放慢，用步伐告诉他"我不怕你"；目光钉在他身上，检查他的手、他的姿态，确认他不再动手；那句话是审问不是尖叫——音量压低反而更有分量。
他——场景方向：接受地板上的现实。动机：疼，且被彻底看穿。目标：重新拼起自己的体面。战术：先让呼吸恢复，眼睛去找"刚才发生了什么"的答案——答案挂在墙上：奖杯和奖牌；他重新给她标价——从"纤细的女孩"到"冠军"；他看她走近，不敢动，眼睛里是疼痛+服气+一点点笑意的萌芽。
（安全线：两人的目光始终有任务——绝不呆滞玻璃化凝视；自然眨眼。）

物理
摔技符合真实柔道力学：借力、转胯、重心破坏——不是超人飞踢；他的体重真实，飞行轨迹是低的抛物线，落地有冲击和余震，落地后不弹起。珠帘被身体穿破：珠串向四周炸开、大幅摆动、互相碰撞作响，逐渐衰减静止——珠串不断裂、不消失。地板闷响。她的步伐从容，珠串沿肩滑开。手不悬浮，身体不失重，无橡胶感CG动作。

灯光——电影感硬性规定
深夜低照度，光必须有方向、有明暗、有层次——绝不允许平光。
第一段（厨房）：油烟机的浓橙色光从左侧打在扭斗的两人身上，是主导光源；红珠帘在纵深发深红光；冷绿窗光从摄影机背后勾他们的轮廓。
第二至五段（走廊）：走廊昏暗，旧黄壁面只被厨房透出的红光和微弱顶光照亮；红光透过珠帘在地板上投点状红斑；奖杯被侧上方一点暖光轻扫——金色金属高光带halation；他一半在红光里、一半在阴影里；第五段她背对红色厨房光——轮廓被红光勾出，面部由走廊微光塑形，有明暗过渡。王家卫式深红+浓橙+冷绿+旧黄配色。绝不允许均匀平光。

对白与声音
她只说一句台词，仅用香港粤语，12.5-14.5秒：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」（"你在这里做什么，Li？"）。发声：平静、低沉、缓慢——每个字都稳；带着无奈和一点责备，像对熟人而不是对贼；不喊叫、不尖锐、不颤抖。
他没有台词——只有落地的闷哼和喘息。无音乐。无字幕、旁白、画外音。
音效：扭斗的布料与皮夹克摩擦、摔技发力的短促呼气、珠帘炸开的哗啦声与衰减碰撞声、身体砸在瓷砖上的闷响、他的喘息、她的小跟鞋两步、珠串沿她肩滑开的轻响、遥远城市声。台词时环境音压低。

正向锁定

【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。

The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装背砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在门厅拐角后一阵摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖、拧腕）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束被拖出拐角的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯——走廊始终黑暗、只有两端反光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.name: loc_RF_entrance_main
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装背砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在门厅拐角后一阵摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖、拧腕）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束被拖出拐角的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯——走廊始终黑暗、只有两端反光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.name: loc_RF_entrance_main
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

(0:00–0:03) 厨房全景（变形宽银幕）：摔投最后一瞬——他绕她的髋部翻转、双脚离地、背朝下砸向珠帘，撞进珠串，湿发甩出几点水星——(0:03) 动作匹配剪辑。(0:03–0:05) 走廊低角度（变形宽银幕）：同一动作接力——他撞破珠帘摔出，背砸瓷砖，一声闷响与被挤出的喘息；湿西装拍在地砖上的闷湿声；珠串四散摆动、红光晃动；走廊自身没有灯，只有两端漏来的反光。(0:05–0:08) 贴地人像特写（变形宽银幕）：他湿着脸躺着喘——刚被泼的那瓶奶留下的湿还挂在脸上，自然、不夸张：一滴奶从颧骨缓缓滑到下巴、悬了一瞬才坠落；稀疏几颗水珠自然地滑进鬓角、睫毛挂着湿光，他眨眼眨掉；湿皮肤在珠帘红反光里反着细碎高光；一脸挨了当头一下的懵——她居然这么对他；胸口起伏渐缓；目光从天花板缓缓移向斜上方——停住：满搁板的金色奖杯、成排奖牌在暗处反着微光进入视野；呼吸停半拍，疼痛让位给一点安静的明白。(0:08–0:09) 一秒插入（变形宽银幕）：<<<96c1833b-2c4d-4765-9a8d-8607602238e5>>>——格斗小人奖杯、层叠绶带奖牌、刻着「世界冠軍・第一名」的小铜牌（道具刻字，非字幕；全段唯一文字）。(0:09–0:12) 低角度仰拍（变形宽银幕）：珠帘余摆中被一只手拨开——她不紧不慢穿出，珠串沿肩滑落轻响；她站在两团微弱红反光之间，在他上方站定，低头说出第一句台词。(0:12–0:17) 硬切她肩上方俯角中景（变形宽银幕）：他一撑起手肘就立刻结结巴巴开口说出第二句台词（0:12.5）——不停顿、不发呆：懵和委屈全在声音和脸上，话不等人；湿衬衫贴着胸口随喘息起伏；说着的同时另一只手臂已经朝头顶方向、朝走廊尽头的门厅拐角伸过去、肩膀微微离地——手绕过拐角的墙棱、直接探进门厅那一侧贴地摸索：手腕拧来拧去、指尖擦过墙皮、拍到门厅地砖、够不着——把身子往门厅方向挪半寸再探深一点；他一边摸一边朝她投去慌乱的眼神，嘴半张着、没有笑——整拍都在找，花束始终没有出现。(0:17–0:19) 硬切她的人像特写（变形宽银幕）：她的头保持不动、不歪头、不低头——所有的怀疑只写在脸上：眉头微微皱起，眼睛慢慢眯细，目光钉在画框外他探进门厅拐角的方向，一次缓慢的眨眼像在计时；嘴角没有一丝笑意，只是平直的一条线：他在那儿干什么？不是惊讶，是审视；画外持续传来摸索的窸窣；珠帘红反光勾着她的轮廓；她自己干净清爽、脸上没有水光。无台词。(0:19–0:22.5) 硬切回她肩上方同一机位：他的手还在门厅拐角后折腾最后一下——牛皮纸哗啦一响，他的手臂绕着墙棱收回、贴地把那束压歪的<<<ac6c43f1-10c1-4a59-96de-059a1512e29a>>>从门厅拐角后拖出（与参考一模一样），金表滑到湿的腕骨上——就在举起花的同一瞬间，他从满脸的慌乱里硬挤出一个讨好的笑、朝她举起，一颗水珠顺着他的鬓角滑下来——再奇怪也是他真心的礼物；她低头看花、停了一拍，才慢慢伸手接过。(0:22.5–0:25) 硬切花束大特写（变形宽银幕）：淡粉牡丹与牛皮纸占满画框，她的脸从画框上缘俯进来，鼻尖轻触花瓣，深吸一口——嘴角浮起一丝几乎看不见的冷笑，睫毛半垂；花瓣在她呼吸里轻颤。(0:25–0:28) 硬切他的仰视视点（变形宽银幕）——她正对镜头，看镜头＝看他：她抬起眼，目光落进镜头停一拍，然后平静、缓慢、一字一顿说出第三句台词（0:25.5）——话音落下的同一瞬间，手腕一甩把花束径直掷向镜头：牛皮纸与粉色花瓣砸满画框、镜头受击猛地一颠——画面在飞来的花束填满视野的瞬间戛然结束。
【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、全部歪着、全部变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装背砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在门厅拐角后一阵摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖、拧腕）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束被拖出拐角的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯——走廊始终黑暗、只有两端反光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.name: loc_RF_entrance_main
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

OPENING DIRECTION (strictly obey): this door opens INWARD — it swings open toward the room, toward the camera side, the leaf sweeping across the foyer floor; the <<<image_1>>> is a printed tiger in the door; it is never pushed outward toward the corridor. CHARACTERS: <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>> — a petite, slender woman, 29, dark low bun, a wine-red pinstripe mandarin-collar top, worn flared jeans, black ankle boots; a red brocade handbag <<<c90567cc-ff94-4dea-ac67-5fbaff636c2e>>> slung on her left shoulder (which sits on her right side within the frame). Her face sits at the right of the frame. Light: the red table lamp rakes in from one side and is the dominant color of the frame; the dim warm yellow of the deep room forms a second layer behind her; the other half of her face falls into heavy shadow — red, yellow and black cleanly separated into three layers.
Performance: her straightening stops halfway — her nostrils move slightly; she is smelling. Her brow knits faintly, her jaw tightens, her eyes no longer look at any object but search the air. She is not afraid, only aware that something is off: there is an odor in this room that does not belong here. She takes another very light breath in, confirming.

Motive: her arms ache, she's weary inside, she just wants to put things down, turn on the light and go quiet. Goal: to confirm this is only her imagination, so the night can go on as normal. Obstacle: the smell does not belong to this room, and her body knew it before her mind did — even as she tells herself it's nothing, she is already tracing the source of the odor. Tactic: first she searches with her nose, then her eyes follow the direction of the smell; that spoken line is not aimed at the audience — it is her saying aloud, for herself, a suspicion she is not yet willing to admit. Do not play fear, do not widen the eyes, no terrified expression — only a tired person suddenly snagged by one small thing. (Safety: keep the gaze always inside the task, never freezing into a blank, unfocused stare; keep a natural blink rhythm.)

SOUND: the door hinge and the lock; the instant the corridor noise is cut off as the door shuts; the "clack" of the lamp switch; the crisp sound of the keys dropping on the wooden top; the faint knock of the brass charm; the heel on the floor tiles; the low hum of the refrigerator compressor; and before she speaks, a stretch of near-total silence so that the single intake of breath is heard very clearly. No music in the whole scene — only an unease slowly tightening inside the quiet.

The two figures stand facing EACH OTHER across the frame — the line between them runs left-to-right. We see BOTH of them IN PROFILE, their bodies and heads turned TOWARD each other. NOT one facing camera and NOT one with their back to camera — both are seen from the side, facing inward toward one another. A MEDIUM SHOT, both figures from about the waist up, with the gap between them visible.

A (BLUE) = the WOMAN, on the RIGHT of frame, standing in PROFILE and FACING LEFT toward B. Her LEFT arm (the one nearer the camera) reaches out to the left and her hand grips B's wrist/forearm. She is small and slim.

B (ORANGE) = the MAN, on the LEFT of frame, standing in PROFILE and FACING RIGHT toward A. BOTH of his hands and forearms are raised up to his face, fully covering it (wiping his eyes). He is taller and bigger than A.

Their raised arms meet in the CENTRE of the frame, in the gap between them.

Simple architecture shapes only: far LEFT a doorway with a hanging bead-curtain (rectangle filled with thin vertical lines) to a corridor; far RIGHT a kitchen counter line with a range-hood shape.

Labels under each figure: "A" (blue) on the right, "B" (orange) on the left. Flat 2D, minimal detail — only who is where, that both face each other in profile, and the hand positions. --ar 16:9 --style raw --stylize 30 --v 8.1 --no photorealism, photo texture, realistic lighting, realistic faces, shading, extra limbs, extra fingers, back view, front view

场景 <<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>（кухня）：狭小老式厨房，红色台灯暖红＋窗的冷绿。
人物：女人 <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>>（женщина）——娇小纤细，酒红条纹立领上衣、喇叭牛仔裤，专业高手。男人 <<<b4fa6063-3664-4359-8a7e-53b9eaf6f3b8>>>（Ли, мужчина）——高大厚实，橄榄绿细条纹西装。【全场绝不清晰露出男人正脸：只有侧后、后脑、被遮住的脸。】

总时长：6秒（一个连续镜头）。

【摄影机运动（本镜头核心）：一个【连续上升】的镜头——起幅【很低、贴近地面，正对两人的腿脚】；随后摄影机【平稳、连贯地向上升起（crane up / 上摇）】，从腿脚一路升到两人的全身高度。整个上升过程【不切、不停】，与下面的动作【同时发生】。】

【连续动作（与镜头上升同步，一气呵成、不停顿）：镜头还在腿脚高度时——女人【用一条腿【伸到男人腿后／勾住他的脚踝或膝弯，做一个绊腿／扫腿（подножка）】，同时上身发力把他往那个方向一带】；随着镜头【向上升起】，男人的重心被这条绊腿彻底破坏、【整个人向后失衡、翻倒】——到镜头升到全身高度时，他正【重重摔倒在厨房地板上】。摔法与镜头上升【无缝衔接】，像一个连续的动作被镜头一路"抬"起来看完。】

结尾：他摔在地上（脸偏一侧、阴影半遮，仍不露正脸）；女人站在他上方，居高临下、呼吸平稳、面不改色。镜头升到位后停住，定格半秒作剪辑余量。

真实性锁定：真实绊摔力学——绊腿＋上身带力，借他的重心把他放倒，不靠蛮力；两人四肢清晰、数量正确，无多余肢体或穿模；摔落有重量感（地板震动）。实时速度、一镜到底、镜头上升与动作连贯同步。

声音：衣料摩擦、脚步与绊倒的踉跄、身体重摔地板的闷响、两人呼吸；她的呼吸始终平稳。无音乐。

【摄影机运动（本镜头核心）：一个【连续上升】的镜头——起幅【很低、贴近地面，正对两人的腿脚】；随后摄影机【平稳、连贯地向上升起（crane up / 上摇）】，从腿脚一路升到两人的全身高度。整个上升过程【不切、不停】，与下面的动作【同时发生】。】

【连续动作（与镜头上升同步，一气呵成、不停顿）：镜头还在腿脚高度时——女人【用一条腿【伸到男人腿后／勾住他的脚踝或膝弯，做一个绊腿／扫腿（подножка）】，同时上身发力把他往那个方向一带】；随着镜头【向上升起】，男人的重心被这条绊腿彻底破坏、【整个人向后失衡、翻倒】——到镜头升到全身高度时，他正【重重摔倒在厨房地板上】。摔法与镜头上升【无缝衔接】，像一个连续的动作被镜头一路"抬"起来看完。】

结尾：他摔在地上（脸偏一侧、阴影半遮，仍不露正脸）；女人站在他上方，居高临下、呼吸平稳、面不改色。镜头升到位后停住，定格半秒作剪辑余量。

真实性锁定：真实绊摔力学——绊腿＋上身带力，借他的重心把他放倒，不靠蛮力；两人四肢清晰、数量正确，无多余肢体或穿模；摔落���重量感（地板震动）。实时速度、���镜到底、镜头上升与动作连贯同步。

声音：衣料摩擦、脚步与绊倒的踉跄、身体重摔地板的闷响、两人呼吸；她的呼吸始终平稳。无音乐。

STYLE: Wong Kar-wai-style Hong Kong neon noir, in the Christopher Doyle cinematographic tradition. Arriflex 35 III, Zeiss Super Speed primes, spherical 1.85:1, Fuji Eterna 500T processed cool — coarse organic grain, soft halation blooming around the practical light sources, shallow depth of field. Low-light night, crushed and moody.

TWO COLOR STAGES (the heart of this scene): Stage one — before the lamp is switched on: the foyer is almost pitch black; the only light is the cold green corridor light leaking in through the open doorway, casting a long thin green band across the floor that rims the door frame and the woman's silhouette. In this stage there is no red and no warm color anywhere; the dominant palette is cold teal-green and black. Stage two — after she presses the table-lamp switch: the red-shaded lamp on the entry cabinet comes on, and a dense magenta/true-red light instantly floods the foyer and becomes the dominant color of the frame; from deep in the room a little dim, warm yellow glows through as a second layer. Red dominant, yellow secondary, black still holding most of the frame; the red light wraps only the area around the lamp and one side of the figure, while the rest of the space sinks fast into deep black. Never raise the overall exposure, never turn it into an evenly lit bright room. This switch-on must read as one clear color turn in the frame: from cold green flipping to warm red.

SET <<<3c8395b4-538e-4294-9182-e6e641c7bb11>>> (the woman's foyer/entryway): narrow and old. Along the left wall a low entry cabinet, on it a red-shaded table lamp, a thermos, a teacup; above the cabinet a round mirror, photographs and a wall calendar; the front door in the center, a red bead curtain hanging beside it; a doormat and a pair of slippers on the floor. The ceiling light is never turned on; outside the window is pitch black.

**DOOR & WHAT LIES OUTSIDE (must obey): this front door is a plain dark brown-red panel — no pattern, no painting, no tiger on it whatsoever. The moment it opens, the doorway reveals the open-air corridor outside <<>> — concrete floor, an old dark-green iron railing, laundry hung on the railing; beyond the railing, the city at night <<<6a2be582-c84d-421c-b54e-838b5e791b63>>> — layer upon layer of tower window-lights and a few vertical red neon signs.**

OPENING DIRECTION (strictly obey): this door opens INWARD — it swings open toward the room, toward the camera side, the leaf sweeping across the foyer floor; the <<<image_1>>> is a printed tiger in the door; it is never pushed outward toward the corridor. The door is hinged on its right side, with the handle and lock on the door's left edge; the woman pushes the door from the corridor, the panel rotates inward to clear the way, she then steps in and pulls the door back shut from inside.

CHARACTERS: <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>> — a petite, slender woman, 29, dark low bun, a wine-red pinstripe mandarin-collar top, worn flared jeans, black ankle boots; a red brocade handbag <<<c90567cc-ff94-4dea-ac67-5fbaff636c2e>>> slung on her left shoulder (which sits on her right side within the frame). The keys <<<4092c004-af57-4f7e-a2bc-4c11d5cdcd5e>>> are an old brass key, with a small brass tiger charm hanging from the key ring.

TOTAL DURATION: 15 seconds.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:07) — OVERHEAD TOP-DOWN + ULTRA-WIDE FISHEYE (the key to this shot, execute strictly): the camera is mounted on the ceiling directly above the front door, flush against the ceiling, the lens pointing straight down (about a 90° downward angle), shooting on an extremely short fisheye / ultra-wide lens. The frame therefore shows strong fisheye distortion: the foyer's four walls and the floor bow and stretch toward the edges of the frame, straight lines become arcs, the center bulges outward while the four corners are compressed and drawn in, the field of view is extremely wide — the effect of a fisheye looking down over the entire entryway from the ceiling. The floor, the doormat, the slippers and the top of the entry cabinet are all pulled into frame; of the person you see only the crown of the head, the two shoulders, and a body extremely foreshortened from above and warped toward the edges — the face is never visible at all. The camera stays locked off throughout, no pan, no move.**
At the top of the shot the foyer is pitch black. The door is pushed open from the corridor side, the leaf rotating inward toward the camera side; under the fisheye distortion the arc of the panel sweeping across the floor is exaggerated into a pronounced curve; **the doorway reveals the open-air corridor outside <<>> and the city night beyond the railing <<<6a2be582-c84d-421c-b54e-838b5e791b63>>>**, and the corridor's cold green light pours in with it, laying a green band of light across the floor. **Both faces of the door panel are plain — no tiger, no pattern on them.** The woman steps in through the doorway (from the top-down angle we first see the crown of her head enter frame), turns, and pulls the door back shut — the green light narrows and disappears as the door closes, and the room drops dark again for a beat.
Immediately she reaches out and presses the switch of the table lamp on the entry cabinet: the red lamp comes on, dense red light floods the foyer at once, and a little dim warm yellow glows through from deep in the room — the frame flips completely from cold green to warm red, and the fisheye lens makes the red light form a bulging core of light at the center of the frame, falling off in a curve toward the edges. In the red light she lifts the red handbag <<<c90567cc-ff94-4dea-ac67-5fbaff636c2e>>> off her left shoulder, leans her upper body forward about thirty degrees, and bends to set things down on the cabinet. The top-down fisheye clearly shows the crown of her head, the line of her shoulders, the arc of her reaching arm, and the objects on the cabinet top. The movements are slow, weary, ordinary.

SHOT 2 (0:07–0:11) — detail close-up, 50mm macro, shallow depth of field, normal perspective, no distortion: her two hands set the red brocade handbag <<>> down on the cabinet top, then lay the ring of brass keys <<<4092c004-af57-4f7e-a2bc-4c11d5cdcd5e>>> beside it — the keys land on the wooden surface with a crisp clink, and the little brass tiger charm swings twice before it stills. At the right of frame is the already-lit red-shaded lamp; its red light falls directly on the brocade satin of the handbag and on the brass keys, the satin throwing back the high sheen peculiar to silk; the red is at its most saturated and most searing in this shot, while the rest of the surface sinks into shadow. There is no face in this shot — only the hands, the handbag, the keys and the lamp.

SHOT 3 (0:11–0:15) — cut to a big close-up of her face, shot on an 85mm medium-telephoto lens, normal perspective, without any wide-angle or fisheye distortion, facial proportions natural and features undistorted, the background compressed by the long lens and softened into a wash of blur: picking up from the previous action — she has just set the things down and is now slowly straightening up from her bent posture, the camera rising with her. Her face sits at the right of the frame. Light: the red table lamp rakes in from one side and is the dominant color of the frame; the dim warm yellow of the deep room forms a second layer behind her; the other half of her face falls into heavy shadow — red, yellow and black cleanly separated into three layers.
Performance: her straightening stops halfway — her nostrils move slightly; she is smelling. Her brow knits faintly, her jaw tightens, her eyes no longer look at any object but search the air. She is not afraid, only aware that something is off: there is an odor in this room that does not belong here. She takes another very light breath in, confirming.
Woman (Cantonese, low, as if asking herself): 「咩味嚟㗎？」 ("What's that smell?")
Having said it, she lifts her eyes, steps off, walks straight forward and exits frame right, her face grazing past the lens and briefly blacking out the frame.

ACTING TASK — the woman (fully committed to her strategy; the acting lives in her eyes and her nose): Scene direction (unspoken): she's home; set the whole day down off her body. Motive: her arms ache, she's weary inside, she just wants to put things down, turn on the light and go quiet. Goal: to confirm this is only her imagination, so the night can go on as normal. Obstacle: the smell does not belong to this room, and her body knew it before her mind did — even as she tells herself it's nothing, she is already tracing the source of the odor. Tactic: first she searches with her nose, then her eyes follow the direction of the smell; that spoken line is not aimed at the audience — it is her saying aloud, for herself, a suspicion she is not yet willing to admit. Do not play fear, do not widen the eyes, no terrified expression — only a tired person suddenly snagged by one small thing. (Safety: keep the gaze always inside the task, never freezing into a blank, unfocused stare; keep a natural blink rhythm.)

SOUND: the door hinge and the lock; the instant the corridor noise is cut off as the door shuts; the "clack" of the lamp switch; the crisp sound of the keys dropping on the wooden top; the faint knock of the brass charm; the heel on the floor tiles; the low hum of the refrigerator compressor; and before she speaks, a stretch of near-total silence so that the single intake of breath is heard very clearly. No music in the whole scene — only an unease slowly tightening inside the quiet.

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

params.prompt:
STYLE: Wong Kar-wai-style Hong Kong neon noir, in the Christopher Doyle cinematographic tradition. Arriflex 35 III, Zeiss Super Speed primes, spherical 1.85:1, Fuji Eterna 500T processed cool — coarse organic grain, soft halation blooming around the practical light sources, shallow depth of field. Low-light night, crushed and moody.

TWO COLOR STAGES (the heart of this scene): Stage one — before the lamp is switched on: the foyer is almost pitch black; the only light is the cold green corridor light leaking in through the open doorway, casting a long thin green band across the floor that rims the door frame and the woman's silhouette. In this stage there is no red and no warm color anywhere; the dominant palette is cold teal-green and black. Stage two — after she presses the table-lamp switch: the red-shaded lamp on the entry cabinet comes on, and a dense magenta/true-red light instantly floods the foyer and becomes the dominant color of the frame; from deep in the room a little dim, warm yellow glows through as a second layer. Red dominant, yellow secondary, black still holding most of the frame; the red light wraps only the area around the lamp and one side of the figure, while the rest of the space sinks fast into deep black. Never raise the overall exposure, never turn it into an evenly lit bright room. This switch-on must read as one clear color turn in the frame: from cold green flipping to warm red.

SET <<<3c8395b4-538e-4294-9182-e6e641c7bb11>>> (the woman's foyer/entryway): narrow and old. Along the left wall a low entry cabinet, on it a red-shaded table lamp, a thermos, a teacup; above the cabinet a round mirror, photographs and a wall calendar; the front door in the center, a red bead curtain hanging beside it; a doormat and a pair of slippers on the floor. The ceiling light is never turned on; outside the window is pitch black.

**DOOR & WHAT LIES OUTSIDE (must obey): this front door is a plain dark brown-red panel — no pattern, no painting, no tiger on it whatsoever. The moment it opens, the doorway reveals the open-air corridor outside <<>> — concrete floor, an old dark-green iron railing, laundry hung on the railing; beyond the railing, the city at night <<<6a2be582-c84d-421c-b54e-838b5e791b63>>> — layer upon layer of tower window-lights and a few vertical red neon signs.**

OPENING DIRECTION (strictly obey): this door opens INWARD — it swings open toward the room, toward the camera side, the leaf sweeping across the foyer floor; it is never pushed outward toward the corridor. The door is hinged on its right side, with the handle and lock on the door's left edge; the woman pushes the door from the corridor, the panel rotates inward to clear the way, she then steps in and pulls the door back shut from inside.

CHARACTERS: <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>> — a petite, slender woman, 29, dark low bun, a wine-red pinstripe mandarin-collar top, worn flared jeans, black ankle boots; a red brocade handbag <<>> slung on her left shoulder (which sits on her right side within the frame). The keys <<<4092c004-af57-4f7e-a2bc-4c11d5cdcd5e>>> are an old brass key, with a small brass tiger charm hanging from the key ring.

TOTAL DURATION: 15 seconds.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:07) — OVERHEAD TOP-DOWN + ULTRA-WIDE FISHEYE (the key to this shot, execute strictly): the camera is mounted on the ceiling directly above the front door, flush against the ceiling, the lens pointing straight down (about a 90° downward angle), shooting on an extremely short fisheye / ultra-wide lens. The frame therefore shows strong fisheye distortion: the foyer's four walls and the floor bow and stretch toward the edges of the frame, straight lines become arcs, the center bulges outward while the four corners are compressed and drawn in, the field of view is extremely wide — the effect of a fisheye looking down over the entire entryway from the ceiling. The floor, the doormat, the slippers and the top of the entry cabinet are all pulled into frame; of the person you see only the crown of the head, the two shoulders, and a body extremely foreshortened from above and warped toward the edges — the face is never visible at all. The camera stays locked off throughout, no pan, no move.**
At the top of the shot the foyer is pitch black. The door is pushed open from the corridor side, the leaf rotating inward toward the camera side; under the fisheye distortion the arc of the panel sweeping across the floor is exaggerated into a pronounced curve; **the doorway reveals the open-air corridor outside <<>> and the city night beyond the railing <<<6a2be582-c84d-421c-b54e-838b5e791b63>>>**, and the corridor's cold green light pours in with it, laying a green band of light across the floor. **Both faces of the door panel are plain — no tiger, no pattern on them.** The woman steps in through the doorway (from the top-down angle we first see the crown of her head enter frame), turns, and pulls the door back shut — the green light narrows and disappears as the door closes, and the room drops dark again for a beat.
Immediately she reaches out and presses the switch of the table lamp on the entry cabinet: the red lamp comes on, dense red light floods the foyer at once, and a little dim warm yellow glows through from deep in the room — the frame flips completely from cold green to warm red, and the fisheye lens makes the red light form a bulging core of light at the center of the frame, falling off in a curve toward the edges. In the red light she lifts the red handbag <<<c90567cc-ff94-4dea-ac67-5fbaff636c2e>>> off her left shoulder, leans her upper body forward about thirty degrees, and bends to set things down on the cabinet. The top-down fisheye clearly shows the crown of her head, the line of her shoulders, the arc of her reaching arm, and the objects on the cabinet top. The movements are slow, weary, ordinary.

SHOT 2 (0:07–0:11) — detail close-up, 50mm macro, shallow depth of field, normal perspective, no distortion: her two hands set the red brocade handbag <<>> down on the cabinet top, then lay the ring of brass keys <<<4092c004-af57-4f7e-a2bc-4c11d5cdcd5e>>> beside it — the keys land on the wooden surface with a crisp clink, and the little brass tiger charm swings twice before it stills. At the right of frame is the already-lit red-shaded lamp; its red light falls directly on the brocade satin of the handbag and on the brass keys, the satin throwing back the high sheen peculiar to silk; the red is at its most saturated and most searing in this shot, while the rest of the surface sinks into shadow. There is no face in this shot — only the hands, the handbag, the keys and the lamp.

SHOT 3 (0:11–0:15) — cut to a big close-up of her face, shot on an 85mm medium-telephoto lens, normal perspective, without any wide-angle or fisheye distortion, facial proportions natural and features undistorted, the background compressed by the long lens and softened into a wash of blur: picking up from the previous action — she has just set the things down and is now slowly straightening up from her bent posture, the camera rising with her. Her face sits at the right of the frame. Light: the red table lamp rakes in from one side and is the dominant color of the frame; the dim warm yellow of the deep room forms a second layer behind her; the other half of her face falls into heavy shadow — red, yellow and black cleanly separated into three layers.
Performance: her straightening stops halfway — her nostrils move slightly; she is smelling. Her brow knits faintly, her jaw tightens, her eyes no longer look at any object but search the air. She is not afraid, only aware that something is off: there is an odor in this room that does not belong here. She takes another very light breath in, confirming.
Woman (Cantonese, low, as if asking herself): 「咩味嚟㗎？」 ("What's that smell?")
Having said it, she lifts her eyes, steps off, walks straight forward and exits frame right, her face grazing past the lens and briefly blacking out the frame.

ACTING TASK — the woman (fully committed to her strategy; the acting lives in her eyes and her nose): Scene direction (unspoken): she's home; set the whole day down off her body. Motive: her arms ache, she's weary inside, she just wants to put things down, turn on the light and go quiet. Goal: to confirm this is only her imagination, so the night can go on as normal. Obstacle: the smell does not belong to this room, and her body knew it before her mind did — even as she tells herself it's nothing, she is already tracing the source of the odor. Tactic: first she searches with her nose, then her eyes follow the direction of the smell; that spoken line is not aimed at the audience — it is her saying aloud, for herself, a suspicion she is not yet willing to admit. Do not play fear, do not widen the eyes, no terrified expression — only a tired person suddenly snagged by one small thing. (Safety: keep the gaze always inside the task, never freezing into a blank, unfocused stare; keep a natural blink rhythm.)

SOUND: the door hinge and the lock; the instant the corridor noise is cut off as the door shuts; the "clack" of the lamp switch; the crisp sound of the keys dropping on the wooden top; the faint knock of the brass charm; the heel on the floor tiles; the low hum of the refrigerator compressor; and before she speaks, a stretch of near-total silence so that the single intake of breath is heard very clearly. No music in the whole scene — only an unease slowly tightening inside the quiet.

params.prompt:
— REFERENCE DEFINITIONS —
<<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>>: 29yo slender East Asian woman, dark low bun, side bangs; wine-red striped tee, flare jeans, kitten heels — 100% per reference; face TOP priority, same person in every shot; she stays clean and dry — no sweat, no droplets. Reference.
<<<b4fa6063-3664-4359-8a7e-53b9eaf6f3b8>>>: East Asian man, 30s, broad shoulders, baggy olive-grey 90s pinstripe suit, open wine-red shirt, gold chain; no rings, gold watch; no cigarette — 100% per reference. Reference.
<<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>: THE only kitchen — every shot 100% this exact room, nothing changed. Narrow old Hong Kong kitchen: entrance fully covered by a red bead curtain; left wall — range hood (dense orange pool), stove, sink; far wall the ONLY window — lace parted, right pane open outward, outside only night (NO ONE there); vases on the sill; white fridge right of the window; right wall — boombox (playing), red-shaded lamp (deep red pool). Dark old tiles. HARD: fridge doors shut whole film, never opened; window and lace stay open.
<<<3d3ee963-9eae-4eeb-88e0-6b6bb5eab4b4>>>:night corridor beyond the beads — dark, red hallway glow at the far end on old tiles; a low trophy shelf against the wall. He lands here on the corridor floor by the trophy shelf. Camera sits INSIDE this corridor.
<<<3a48e4da-5b33-46b6-bb06-501fe3d1dcf4>>>: pair of vases on the sill. Prop.
<<<14b4c317-ed1f-4613-88ee-cb8ed0a7208b>>>: glass milk bottle, no cap, 70% full. Stays in her hands until it FALLS to the floor — never swung, never set down.
— TECHNICAL BLOCK —
Ultra filmic, Wong Kar-wai mood, 35mm Kodak 500T grain, halation, anamorphic oval bokeh, real skin with pores — no plastic skin, NO CGI, NON-IP. 21:9. 13s. Five shots, four hard cuts. Handheld shoulder camera in EVERY shot, one jolt per impact; no tripod, no gimbal. Every position FIXED: NO push-in, pull-out, zoom, dolly, tracking — breathing drift only; shot size changes ONLY via hard cuts. NO FIGHT, NO grappling exchange — ONE instant chain: she hurls the milk in his face(<<<14b4c317-ed1f-4613-88ee-cb8ed0a7208b>>>FALLS from her hands and shatters on the floor) → the SAME motion carries straight into ONE hip throw → he is thrown a SHORT, REALISTIC distance through the bead curtain and lands on the corridor floor by the trophy shelf. No arm-capture, no coil, no blocks, no punches, no back-and-forth. He never attacks. Everything proportional and physically real — a real human body thrown by a hip toss travels only about 1.5–2 meters and lands hard on the floor; NOT flung across the room, NOT flying over the camera, NO wire-work exaggeration. FINAL shot (0:08–0:13) is TRUE SLOW MOTION — ~120fps high-speed look, uniformly slowed: real physics, crisp frames, NO smear, NO speed ramps; sound slowed and muffled. Off-center framing. Diegetic sound only.
— PROMPT —
Four hard cuts, positions locked. Three lights: hood orange, deep red of beads and lamp, cool green night from the window — no flat light, halation everywhere.
(0:00–0:00.5) Half-second wide shot to set positions — camera inside the bead doorway ~60cm up, low angle along the <<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>> axis: loud music, breeze, lace fluttering; <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>> holds <<<14b4c317-ed1f-4613-88ee-cb8ed0a7208b>>> facing the window, frame-right third, fridge shut beside her; <<<b4fa6063-3664-4359-8a7e-53b9eaf6f3b8>>>stands three steps behind, center-left, half in shadow.
(0:00.5–0:03.5) Hard cut, window-POV close-up: defocused lace at frame-left; <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>>'s face at the left third — cool green on one side, soft shadow on the other (~3:1); face calm: one sip of milk, then only her eyes sweep and settle on the reflection in the closed left pane; behind her, defocused, <<<b4fa6063-3664-4359-8a7e-53b9eaf6f3b8>>>creeps closer, hands still down.
(0:03.5–0:05) Hard cut, glass-reflection close-up: the dark pane mirrors both — <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>> with <<<14b4c317-ed1f-4613-88ee-cb8ed0a7208b>>>, <<<b4fa6063-3664-4359-8a7e-53b9eaf6f3b8>>> right behind, hands rising to grab.
(0:05–0:08) Hard cut, same window-POV — THE SPLASH THAT BECOMES THE THROW, one continuous move, NO cut inside it: the instant his fingertips reach her face, <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>> spins and hurls all the milk into his face — a glowing white arc in cool backlight; his startled "oh!", hands flying to his own eyes; <<<14b4c317-ed1f-4613-88ee-cb8ed0a7208b>>> simply FALLS out of her hands mid-spin — she has no time to set it down — it drops straight down and SHATTERS on the floor tiles at their feet. Without a pause, the SAME spin carries her in low under him: she steps in, hips dropping, and loads him onto her hip — one smooth economical motion, splash flowing directly into the throw, no grabbing struggle, no coil; only a strangled natural grunt from him, short panicked wet gasps, NO words; the shot cuts on the first millimeter of the throw's launch.
(0:08–0:13) SLOW-MOTION WIDE THROUGH THE BEADS — THE THROW AND THE LANDING: hard cut to the kitchen doorway: the FRAME IS <<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>seen from its own entrance — same axis, same layout, the whole warm kitchen readable in depth (orange hood pool left, red lamp glow right, open window far) — with the red bead strands hanging across the entire FOREGROUND, glinting against the kitchen glow; the camera sits LOW (~40cm) INSIDE <<<3d3ee963-9eae-4eeb-88e0-6b6bb5eab4b4>>>on the dark corridor side of the curtain, tilted slightly up; the dark corridor with the trophy shelf is around and behind the camera. The entire shot in uniform slow motion (~120fps): behind the strands, INSIDE THE KITCHEN, the throw completes — [LEE]'s body arcs over her hip in slowed real physics, feet leaving the ground, wet suit flaring in the orange light; he is thrown a SHORT REALISTIC distance — over her hip, low arc, head-and-shoulders first — bursting THROUGH the bead curtain into the corridor: red beads scatter in slow motion, strands whipping in long slow arcs; he lands HARD on the dark corridor floor just past the doorway, by the trophy shelf, back and shoulder hitting the old tiles — a heavy realistic impact, a couple of trophies rattling on the shelf; head toward the red hallway glow, feet toward the kitchen doorway (NEVER reversed). He does NOT fly over the camera, does NOT sail across the room — a real human distance, ~1.5m. One heavy slowed frame-jolt on impact; the camera never moves; the film ends inside the slow motion — torn strands still swinging in the doorway, and through them, in the warm kitchen, <<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>>'s figure finishing the rotation, settling onto both feet.
<<<e6464cdb-89c2-4580-88e7-cb2ea6547919>>>fights like a black widow: calm, economical, using his weight and momentum; ONE instant chain only — splash → immediately the hip throw — no arm-capture, no coil, no blocks, no punches, no back-and-forth; real judo mechanics, low arc, proportional realistic distance, no wires, no CG; both unharmed. Only these two people; the throw starts inside the kitchen and he lands just through the doorway in the corridor by the trophy shelf; the kitchen is 100% <<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>, the corridor 100% <<<3d3ee963-9eae-4eeb-88e0-6b6bb5eab4b4>>>— never another room; window open, breeze all through; fridge shut; milk puddle and shards stay; her face clean and dry; framing never centered; no push/pull/zoom.

风格：王家卫式香港霓虹黑色电影，杜可风摄影传统。武打＝【太极推手＋擒拿】的近身控制流：以柔克刚、借力使力、圆滑连贯，用杠杆与关节把对手放倒，不靠蛮力、不硬碰硬。Arriflex 35 III，蔡司 Super Speed 定焦，球面 1.85:1，浅景深。夜、低照度、压暗。色调：厨房红色台灯暖红＋窗外冷青绿对撞（红为主、绿为辅、黑占大面积）；绝不明亮。无字幕、无文字、无水印。

【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【SCENE / 场景】
深夜，香港旧公寓。她刚把闯入者摔向珠帘——本段从落点开始：他摔进走廊、看见满墙奖杯；她走出来问了一句，他却把手伸向身旁的墙角、从墙角后面摸出一束花；她眯眼审视，接过闻了闻，笑了一下，然后给了他答案。身体部分是电影武术编排的收尾——画面只呈现动作、位置与重心的变化，落地有冲击但无任何伤痕。

她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向墙角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。

【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在

第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、全部歪着、全部变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去墙角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向墙角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向墙角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装背砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在墙角后面一阵摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖、拧腕）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束被拖出墙角的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

2.39:1，比例正确。人物的脸与身体是真实人体比例，与参考图完全一致。角色参考图的脸必须与生成的脸是同一个人：骨相、眉眼间距、鼻梁、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发型。若任何构图或风格指令会让脸偏离参考图，放弃那条指令，保住脸。

35mm Kodak Vision3 500T彩色负片｜变形宽银幕定焦（anamorphic）——每帧都是变形镜头：竖椭圆焦外光斑、画框左右边缘柔和anamorphic涂抹、细腻胶片颗粒、柔和高光滚降；灯具周围只有柔和halation——绝无放射状光芒、星芒。景别变化一律HARD CUT到另一真实机位，不用推拉与变焦。

全片纪录片式肩扛手持，地平线始终歪着（3–6°），画框每秒呼吸与漂移。平静段＝呼吸级漂移；动作段＝每次冲击一次可见画框颠动。脸永远由中焦人像镜头拍摄。
■ 材质
皮肤、金属、纸、花瓣、布、瓷砖照片级实拍：毛孔、汗、湿的皮肤是湿的、水珠是一颗颗真实滚动的、牛皮纸褶皱真实。夸张只发生在节奏上，不发生在材质上。
■ 表演
不演情绪，演贯彻自己战术的过程；戏在眼睛里。安全线：视线始终在执行任务，绝不呆滞空洞凝视；自然眨眼。不瞪眼、不嘶吼、不挤眉弄眼。

动漫、速度线、smear帧、插画感、游戏CG、塑料皮肤、磨皮；换脸；推拉、变焦、稳定器顺滑、三脚架死静、水平地平线；放射状光芒、过曝发白；字幕、Logo、水印。

走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.name: loc_RF_entrance_main
reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、歪着、变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家是她唯一卸下防备的地方。目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊里没有光：唯一的光是厨房和门厅漏进来的
走廊没有任何灯、没有任何光源——画面接近黑。全段只有两处光：厨房珠帘门洞漏出的红反光（微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃）和门厅红罩台灯漏出的暖红余晖（铺在尽头地砖和墙面下部）。绝无任何光直接打在他身上：他躺在两团反光之间的黑暗里，整个人几乎是黑的剪影，只有轮廓边缘偶尔被门洞反光擦出一线极弱的红边，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里；她也一样——背后珠帘红勾边、正面门厅暖红极弱托起，明暗远大于3:1。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在拐角后摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束拖出的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；任何光束或灯光直接打在他身上——他只被两端门洞的反光勾边；走廊出现自己的顶灯、壁灯或任何新光源——走廊始终黑暗；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【FILM STYLE — 全片固定，每段都用同一套】
■ 比例与同一性（最高优先，压倒其他一切指令）
2.39:1，比例正确。人物的脸与身体是真实人体比例，与参考图完全一致。角色参考图的脸必须与生成的脸是同一个人：骨相、眉眼间距、鼻梁、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发型。若任何构图或风格指令会让脸偏离参考图，放弃那条指令，保住脸。
■ 摄影机·胶片·镜头
35mm Kodak Vision3 500T彩色负片｜变形宽银幕定焦（anamorphic）——每帧都是变形镜头：竖椭圆焦外光斑、画框左右边缘柔和anamorphic涂抹、细腻胶片颗粒、柔和高光滚降；灯具周围只有柔和halation——绝无放射状光芒、星芒。景别变化一律HARD CUT到另一真实机位，不用推拉与变焦。
■ 两种手持强度（本片签名）
全片纪录片式肩扛手持，地平线始终歪着（3–6°），画框每秒呼吸与漂移。平静段＝呼吸级漂移；动作段＝每次冲击一次可见画框颠动。脸永远由中焦人像镜头拍摄。
■ 材质
皮肤、金属、纸、花瓣、布、瓷砖照片级实拍：毛孔、汗、湿的皮肤是湿的、水珠是一颗颗真实滚动的、牛皮纸褶皱真实。夸张只发生在节奏上，不发生在材质上。
■ 表演
不演情绪，演贯彻自己战术的过程；戏在眼睛里。安全线：视线始终在执行任务，绝不呆滞空洞凝视；自然眨眼。不瞪眼、不嘶吼、不挤眉弄眼。
■ 声音
只有画内声：从厨房透来的收录机老歌、环境声与动作声。无配乐、无旁白、无字幕。
■ 全片禁止
动漫、速度线、smear帧、插画感、游戏CG、塑料皮肤、磨皮；换脸；推拉、变焦、稳定器顺滑、三脚架死静、水平地平线；放射状光芒、过曝发白；字幕、Logo、水印。
【REFERENCES】（按优先级）
1. <<<7860dd11-06df-4111-b144-346ef9babfb9>>>——女主的脸，最高优先。29岁纤细东亚女子，深色低发髻、斜分刘海；酒红条纹立领短袖上衣、做旧低腰喇叭牛仔裤、棕色金属饰腰带、黑色小跟鞋。她全程干净清爽：不出汗、头发不湿、脸上没有水光、绝无任何水珠或液滴。

3. <<<1ae9138c-1579-4036-9334-104fc7ecbde7>>>——主场景：深夜走廊，旧黄斑驳的墙面，旧瓷砖地面，左侧珠帘门洞透出红光；门洞右侧墙上一层木搁板摆满金色武术奖杯，搁板下挂几十枚彩色绶带奖牌。走廊本身没有任何亮着的灯。

【SCENE / 场景】

走廊没有任何灯、没有任何光源——画面接近黑。全段只有两处光：厨房珠帘门洞漏出的红反光（微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃）和门厅红罩台灯漏出的暖红余晖（铺在尽头地砖和墙面下部）。绝无任何光直接打在他身上：他躺在两团反光之间的黑暗里，整个人几乎是黑的剪影，只有轮廓边缘偶尔被门洞反光擦出一线极弱的红边，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里；她也一样——背后珠帘红勾边、正面门厅暖红极弱托起，明暗远大于3:1。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。

第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；任何光束或灯光直接打在他身上——他只被两端门洞的反光勾边；走廊出现自己的顶灯、壁灯或任何新光源——走廊始终黑暗；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、歪着、变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家是她唯一卸下防备的地方。目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊里没有光：唯一的光是厨房和门厅漏进来的
走廊没有任何灯、没有任何光源——画面接近黑。全段只有两处光：厨房珠帘门洞漏出的红反光（微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃）和门厅红罩台灯漏出的暖红余晖（铺在尽头地砖和墙面下部）。绝无任何光直接打在他身上：他躺在两团反光之间的黑暗里，整个人几乎是黑的剪影，只有轮廓边缘偶尔被门洞反光擦出一线极弱的红边，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里；她也一样——背后珠帘红勾边、正面门厅暖红极弱托起，明暗远大于3:1。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在拐角后摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束拖出的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；任何光束或灯光直接打在他身上——他只被两端门洞的反光勾边；走廊出现自己的顶灯、壁灯或任何新光源——走廊始终黑暗；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【FILM STYLE — 全片固定，每段都用同一套】
■ 比例与同一性（最高优先，压倒其他一切指令）
2.39:1，比例正确。人物的脸与身体是真实人体比例，与参考图完全一致。角色参考图的脸必须与生成的脸是同一个人：骨相、眉眼间距、鼻梁、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发型。若任何构图或风格指令会让脸偏离参考图，放弃那条指令，保住脸。
■ 摄影机·胶片·镜头
35mm Kodak Vision3 500T彩色负片｜变形宽银幕定焦（anamorphic）——每帧都是变形镜头：竖椭圆焦外光斑、画框左右边缘柔和anamorphic涂抹、细腻胶片颗粒、柔和高光滚降；灯具周围只有柔和halation——绝无放射状光芒、星芒。景别变化一律HARD CUT到另一真实机位，不用推拉与变焦。
■ 两种手持强度（本片签名）
全片纪录片式肩扛手持，地平线始终歪着（3–6°），画框每秒呼吸与漂移。平静段＝呼吸级漂移；动作段＝每次冲击一次可见画框颠动。脸永远由中焦人像镜头拍摄。
■ 材质
皮肤、金属、纸、花瓣、布、瓷砖照片级实拍：毛孔、汗、湿的皮肤是湿的、水珠是一颗颗真实滚动的、牛皮纸褶皱真实。夸张只发生在节奏上，不发生在材质上。
■ 表演
不演情绪，演贯彻自己战术的过程；戏在眼睛里。安全线：视线始终在执行任务，绝不呆滞空洞凝视；自然眨眼。不瞪眼、不嘶吼、不挤眉弄眼。
■ 声音
只有画内声：从厨房透来的收录机老歌、环境声与动作声。无配乐、无旁白、无字幕。
■ 全片禁止
动漫、速度线、smear帧、插画感、游戏CG、塑料皮肤、磨皮；换脸；推拉、变焦、稳定器顺滑、三脚架死静、水平地平线；放射状光芒、过曝发白；字幕、Logo、水印。
【REFERENCES】（按优先级）
1. <<<7860dd11-06df-4111-b144-346ef9babfb9>>>——女主的脸，最高优先。29岁纤细东亚女子，深色低发髻、斜分刘海；酒红条纹立领短袖上衣、做旧低腰喇叭牛仔裤、棕色金属饰腰带、黑色小跟鞋。她全程干净清爽：不出汗、头发不湿、脸上没有水光、绝无任何水珠或液滴。

3. <<<1ae9138c-1579-4036-9334-104fc7ecbde7>>>——主场景：深夜走廊，旧黄斑驳的墙面，旧瓷砖地面，左侧珠帘门洞透出红光；门洞右侧墙上一层木搁板摆满金色武术奖杯，搁板下挂几十枚彩色绶带奖牌。走廊本身没有任何亮着的灯。

【SCENE / 场景】

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、歪着、变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家是她唯一卸下防备的地方。目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」

【LIGHT / 光】——走廊里没有光：唯一的光是厨房和门厅漏进来的
走廊没有任何灯、没有任何光源——画面接近黑。全段只有两处光：厨房珠帘门洞漏出的红反光（微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃）和门厅红罩台灯漏出的暖红余晖（铺在尽头地砖和墙面下部）。绝无任何光直接打在他身上：他躺在两团反光之间的黑暗里，整个人几乎是黑的剪影，只有轮廓边缘偶尔被门洞反光擦出一线极弱的红边，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里；她也一样——背后珠帘红勾边、正面门厅暖红极弱托起，明暗远大于3:1。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在拐角后摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束拖出的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；任何光束或灯光直接打在他身上——他只被两端门洞的反光勾边；走廊出现自己的顶灯、壁灯或任何新光源——走廊始终黑暗；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【FILM STYLE — 全片固定，每段都用同一套】
■ 比例与同一性（最高优先，压倒其他一切指令）
2.39:1，比例正确。人物的脸与身体是真实人体比例，与参考图完全一致。角色参考图的脸必须与生成的脸是同一个人：骨相、眉眼间距、鼻梁、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发型。若任何构图或风格指令会让脸偏离参考图，放弃那条指令，保住脸。
■ 摄影机·胶片·镜头
35mm Kodak Vision3 500T彩色负片｜变形宽银幕定焦（anamorphic）——每帧都是变形镜头：竖椭圆焦外光斑、画框左右边缘柔和anamorphic涂抹、细腻胶片颗粒、柔和高光滚降；灯具周围只有柔和halation——绝无放射状光芒、星芒。景别变化一律HARD CUT到另一真实机位，不用推拉与变焦。
■ 两种手持强度（本片签名）
全片纪录片式肩扛手持，地平线始终歪着（3–6°），画框每秒呼吸与漂移。平静段＝呼吸级漂移；动作段＝每次冲击一次可见画框颠动。脸永远由中焦人像镜头拍摄。
■ 材质
皮肤、金属、纸、花瓣、布、瓷砖照片级实拍：毛孔、汗、湿的皮肤是湿的、水珠是一颗颗真实滚动的、牛皮纸褶皱真实。夸张只发生在节奏上，不发生在材质上。
■ 表演
不演情绪，演贯彻自己战术的过程；戏在眼睛里。安全线：视线始终在执行任务，绝不呆滞空洞凝视；自然眨眼。不瞪眼、不嘶吼、不挤眉弄眼。
■ 声音
只有画内声：从厨房透来的收录机老歌、环境声与动作声。无配乐、无旁白、无字幕。
■ 全片禁止
动漫、速度线、smear帧、插画感、游戏CG、塑料皮肤、磨皮；换脸；推拉、变焦、稳定器顺滑、三脚架死静、水平地平线；放射状光芒、过曝发白；字幕、Logo、水印。

1. <<<7860dd11-06df-4111-b144-346ef9babfb9>>>——女主的脸，最高优先。29岁纤细东亚女子，深色低发髻、斜分刘海；酒红条纹立领短袖上衣、做旧低腰喇叭牛仔裤、棕色金属饰腰带、黑色小跟鞋。她全程干净清爽：不出汗、头发不湿、脸上没有水光、绝无任何水珠或液滴。

3. <<<1ae9138c-1579-4036-9334-104fc7ecbde7>>>——主场景：深夜走廊，旧黄斑驳的墙面，旧瓷砖地面，左侧珠帘门洞透出红光；门洞右侧墙上一层木搁板摆满金色武术奖杯，搁板下挂几十枚彩色绶带奖牌。走廊本身没有任何亮着的灯。

【SCENE / 场景】

他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去门厅拐角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向拐角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。

【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向拐角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。

第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；香烟或纸包出现在任何一帧（忽略参考图里的这两样）；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是走廊尽头门厅拐角后的地面；花束外观偏离参考；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；她脸上出现任何水珠、液滴、汗或水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯——走廊始终黑暗、只有两端反光；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

2.39:1，比例正确。人物的脸与身体是真实人体比例，与参考图完全一致。角色参考图的脸必须与生成的脸是同一个人：骨相、眉眼间距、鼻梁、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发型。若任何构图或风格指令会让脸偏离参考图，放弃那条指令，保住脸。

35mm Kodak Vision3 500T彩色负片｜变形宽银幕定焦（anamorphic）——每帧都是变形镜头：竖椭圆焦外光斑、画框左右边缘柔和anamorphic涂抹、细腻胶片颗粒、柔和高光滚降；灯具周围只有柔和halation——绝无放射状光芒、星芒。景别变化一律HARD CUT到另一真实机位，不用推拉与变焦。

全片纪录片式肩扛手持，地平线始终歪着（3–6°），画框每秒呼吸与漂移。平静段＝呼吸级漂移；动作段＝每次冲击一次可见画框颠动。脸永远由中焦人像镜头拍摄。

皮肤、金属、纸、花瓣、布、瓷砖照片级实拍：毛孔、汗、湿的皮肤是湿的、水珠是一颗颗真实滚动的、牛皮纸褶皱真实。夸张只发生在节奏上，不发生在材质上。

不演情绪，演贯彻自己战术的过程；戏在眼睛里。安全线：视线始终在执行任务，绝不呆滞空洞凝视；自然眨眼。不瞪眼、不嘶吼、不挤眉弄眼。

第一拍在厨房：他被牵着手臂绕髋翻转、朝珠帘门洞飞出。之后全部在走廊：他背朝下落在走廊地板中央、头朝奖杯墙一侧，全段躺着不起身，最多撑起一只手肘。关键：他倒下的位置紧挨珠帘门洞的墙棱——墙角在他一条手臂能够到的地方，花束平放在墙棱正后方的地砖上、机位看不见的死角：不在洞里、不在缝里、不在他身上。她随后拨帘走出，站定在他身侧上方，之后不再移动脚步。奖杯搁板在他视线斜上方。
【ACTION / 动作】
(0:00–0:03) 厨房全景（变形宽银幕）：摔投最后一瞬——他绕她的髋部翻转、双脚离地、背朝下砸向珠帘，撞进珠串，湿发甩出几点水星——(0:03) 动作匹配剪辑。(0:03–0:05) 走廊低角度（变形宽银幕）：同一动作接力——他撞破珠帘摔出，背砸瓷砖，一声闷响与被挤出的喘息；湿西装拍在地砖上的闷湿声；珠串四散摆动、红光晃动；走廊自身没有灯，只有两端漏来的反光。(0:05–0:08) 贴地人像特写（变形宽银幕）：他湿着脸躺着喘——水珠从太阳穴滑进鬓角、一颗从下巴坠到地砖上，睫毛挂着湿光，他眨眼把水眨掉；湿皮肤在珠帘红反光里反着细碎高光；一脸挨了当头一下的懵——她居然这么对他；胸口起伏渐缓；目光从天花板缓缓移向斜上方——停住：满搁板的金色奖杯、成排奖牌在暗处反着微光进入视野；呼吸停半拍，疼痛让位给一点安静的明白。(0:08–0:09) 一秒插入（变形宽银幕）：<<<96c1833b-2c4d-4765-9a8d-8607602238e5>>>——格斗小人奖杯、层叠绶带奖牌、刻着「世界冠軍・第一名」的小铜牌（道具刻字，非字幕；全段唯一文字）。(0:09–0:12) 低角度仰拍（变形宽银幕）：珠帘余摆中被一只手拨开——她不紧不慢穿出，珠串沿肩滑落轻响；她站在两团微弱红反光之间，在他上方站定，低头说出第一句台词。(0:12–0:17) 硬切她肩上方俯角中景（变形宽银幕）：他一撑起手肘就立刻结结巴巴开口说出第二句台词（0:12.5）——不停顿、不发呆：懵和委屈全在声音和脸上，话不等人；湿衬衫贴着胸口随喘息起伏；说着的同时另一只手臂已经朝墙角伸过去、肩膀微微离地、手绕过墙棱探进墙角正后方的死角——开始长长地摸摸索索：手腕拧来拧去、指尖擦过墙皮、拍到地砖、够不着——把身子往前挪半寸再探深一点；他一边摸一边朝她投去慌乱的眼神，嘴半张着、没有笑——整拍都在找，花束始终没有出现。(0:17–0:19) 硬切她的人像特写（变形宽银幕）：她的头保持不动、不歪头、不低头——所有的怀疑只写在脸上：眉头微微皱起，眼睛慢慢眯细，目光钉在画框外他摸进墙角的方向，一次缓慢的眨眼像在计时；嘴角没有一丝笑意，只是平直的一条线：他在那儿干什么？不是惊讶，是审视；画外持续传来摸索的窸窣；珠帘红反光勾着她的轮廓；她自己干净清爽、脸上没有水光。无台词。(0:19–0:22.5) 硬切回她肩上方同一机位：他的手还在墙角后面折腾最后一下——牛皮纸哗啦一响，他的手臂绕着墙棱收回、贴地把那束压歪的<<<ac6c43f1-10c1-4a59-96de-059a1512e29a>>>从墙角正后方拖出（与参考一模一样），金表滑到湿的腕骨上——就在举起花的同一瞬间，他从满脸的慌乱里硬挤出一个讨好的笑、朝她举起，一颗水珠顺着他的鬓角滑下来——再奇怪也是他真心的礼物；她低头看花、停了一拍，才慢慢伸手接过。(0:22.5–0:25) 硬切花束大特写（变形宽银幕）：淡粉牡丹与牛皮纸占满画框，她的脸从画框上缘俯进来，鼻尖轻触花瓣，深吸一口——嘴角浮起一丝几乎看不见的冷笑，睫毛半垂；花瓣在她呼吸里轻颤。(0:25–0:28) 硬切他的仰视视点（变形宽银幕）——她正对镜头，看镜头＝看他：她抬起眼，目光落进镜头停一拍，然后平静、缓慢、一字一顿说出第三句台词（0:25.5）——话音落下的同一瞬间，手腕一甩把花束径直掷向镜头：牛皮纸与粉色花瓣砸满画框、镜头受击猛地一颠——画面在飞来的花束填满视野的瞬间戛然结束。
【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、全部歪着、全部变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去墙角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向墙角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向墙角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装背砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在墙角后面一阵摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖、拧腕）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束被拖出墙角的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

— REFERENCE DEFINITIONS —
<<<7860dd11-06df-4111-b144-346ef9babfb9>>>: 29岁纤细东亚女子，深色低发髻、斜分刘海，酒红条纹立领短袖上衣、做旧低腰喇叭牛仔裤、黑色小跟鞋——外貌100%按此参考，必须与参考图是同一个人；全程干净清爽：不出汗、头发不湿、脸上没有水光，下巴与嘴角干净干燥、绝无任何液滴。Character appearance only. Reference.
<<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>: 本片唯一的厨房——第一拍的画面必须100%就是参考图里的这一间：同一布局、同一家具、同一光源，一件都不改；入口整面红珠帘、左墙油烟机（暖橙光池）与灶台水槽、尽头敞开的窗（冷绿夜光、蕾丝帘拨开）、右墙收录机（正在放歌）与红罩台灯（浓红光池）、深色旧地砖。第二拍里它只是她身后彻底失焦的光斑背景。Reference.
— TECHNICAL BLOCK —
Ultra filmic, Wong Kar-wai mood, pristine 35mm Kodak 500T scan — fine organic grain, halation, rich organic color, real skin texture with visible pores — no plastic skin, NO CGI, NON-IP; no compression softness, no smearing, no low-res mush. 21:9. 5s. TWO shots, ONE hard cut. Shot 1 (0:00–0:01): WIDE from the bead doorway — she FACES THE CAMERA, full figure, standing just ONE STEP from the BEAD CURTAIN — close to the camera, LARGE in frame; the window is FAR BEHIND her in the depth. She is NOT near the window. Shot 2 (0:01–0:05): 300mm anamorphic telephoto EXTREME close-up, aperture wide open — paper-thin depth of field, ONLY her face sharp; she stands in the exact same spot — one step from the BEADS, far from the window — the strands read as soft vertical blur bands at the frame edges purely because of the 300mm compression. Cameras FIXED — breathing handheld drift only: NO push-in, NO pull-out, NO zoom, NO tracking, NO rack focus. From the first frame her gaze is ON HIM (off-screen beyond the beads, past the lens) — she NEVER looks into the lens. Her look is NOT sinister or menacing — just mildly tense after the fight, then only her eyes widen slightly — mouth stays CLOSED, no open-mouth surprise, no dramatic expression. Lips relaxed, closed, STILL — no biting, no pressing, no speaking; chin clean and DRY. Diegetic sound only.
— PROMPT —
两拍5秒，一次硬切。男人刚刚被她摔出去、穿帘飞进走廊——全部发生在开拍前、画外。【第一拍】(0:00–0:01) 大全景，纯交代站位：机位在红珠帘门洞处、与胸口齐平，朝厨房纵深、朝窗户方向拍——画面就是<<<61513ce8-8e0e-4223-be14-4545dd9cd000>>>参考图的这间厨房：油烟机的浓橙光池、红罩台灯的深红、尽头窗口的冷绿，收录机大声放着歌；她全身入画、正面朝镜头（面朝珠帘门洞、朝他被摔出去的方向看着画外的他），站在离红珠帘只有一步的地方——也就是离机位很近、在画面里显大，而窗户远远在她身后的纵深里；她绝不站在窗边、绝不站在厨房深处——就在珠帘跟前一步的位置：双脚站定、肩膀还没完全松下来；珠帘的珠串在镜头旁前景里还在余摆、哗啦声正在稀下来，红反光在她身上晃；地上有奶滩和碎玻璃。就一秒，站位一眼可读。【第二拍】(0:01–0:05) 硬切到300mm长焦她的面部超大特写：机位在珠帘门洞处朝厨房纵深拍，她站在与第一拍完全相同的位置——离红珠帘一步、离机位很近，窗户远在她身后的纵深里；脸占据画面中央偏左，头微微低着、下颌收着，眼睛从眉骨下方抬起、目光从一开始就落在他身上——他摔进了珠帘外的走廊（画外），她的视线越过镜头旁、朝珠帘外他倒下的方向盯着他，明显偏离镜头轴线，绝不看镜头、绝不与观众对视；一道红光从右上斜切过她的发顶、额角与颧骨，另一侧脸沉在偏冷的暗调里；长焦把纵深压扁：珠帘的几串竖向虚影出现在画框两侧前景，纯粹是压缩造成的——她并不贴着帘子；背景暖黄与冷绿的巨大光斑、右上一粒红点，全部深度失焦，只有她的脸锐利、毛孔可见。这一拍只演一件事：她的情绪转变——从打完后的轻微紧绷，到终于反应过来自己刚才打的是谁；她不阴森、不凶狠、不吓人。(0:01–0:02) 她已经在看他：紧绷的注视——呼吸还没平，眼神因刚动完手而绷着，落在画外他倒下的方向，仅此而已，绝无杀气；珠帘虚影轻轻荡着、声音稀成零星轻响。(0:02) 反应正落在这一秒，而且只发生在眼睛里：还是同一个注视，但她终于认出了他——紧绷的眼神里，眼睛微微睁大一点点，仅此而已（幅度极小，绝不夸张、绝不瞪眼）；嘴巴纹丝不动、始终闭着——绝不张嘴、绝无任何"惊讶"的表情、脸上没有戏剧化的变化；她就是站着、看着，只有眼睛变了。(0:02–0:05) 她保持这个怔住的状态：呼吸放缓，只有睫毛一次极轻的颤动，珠帘虚影彻底静下来——嘴唇全程放松闭合、纹丝不动：绝不咬唇、绝不抿嘴、绝不张嘴；画面在她目光仍怔在原处的瞬间戛然结束。全片只有她一个人；两个机位都原地固定、绝不移动、绝不移焦；她的目光全程绝不落进镜头；没有台词、没有任何嘴部动作；不微笑、不流泪、不皱鼻；面部与下巴始终干净干燥、绝无液滴或水光；厨房必须是参考图的同一间；绝不提亮、绝无平光；构图偏心不居中；绝无推近拉远变焦。
SOUND: Loud diegetic 90s Hong Kong ballad from the boombox (louder in the wide shot, in-scene) — under it: bead strands still clattering and quickly decaying to sparse soft clicks, one heavy breath settling into slow nose-breathing, faint night breeze from the open window. NO dialogue, NO lip movement, no subtitles. No music score besides the diegetic song.

【FILM STYLE — 全片固定，每段都用同一套】
■ 比例与同一性（最高优先，压倒其他一切指令）
2.39:1，比例正确。人物的脸与身体是真实人体比例，与参考图完全一致。角色参考图的脸必须与生成的脸是同一个人：骨相、眉眼间距、鼻梁、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发型。若任何构图或风格指令会让脸偏离参考图，放弃那条指令，保住脸。
■ 摄影机·胶片·镜头
35mm Kodak Vision3 500T彩色负片｜变形宽银幕定焦（anamorphic）——每帧都是变形镜头：竖椭圆焦外光斑、画框左右边缘柔和anamorphic涂抹、细腻胶片颗粒、柔和高光滚降；灯具周围只有柔和halation——绝无放射状光芒、星芒。景别变化一律HARD CUT到另一真实机位，不用推拉与变焦。
■ 两种手持强度（本片签名）
全片纪录片式肩扛手持，地平线始终歪着（3–6°），画框每秒呼吸与漂移。平静段＝呼吸级漂移；动作段＝每次冲击一次可见画框颠动。脸永远由中焦人像镜头拍摄。
■ 材质
皮肤、金属、纸、花瓣、布、瓷砖照片级实拍：毛孔、汗、湿的皮肤是湿的、水珠是一颗颗真实滚动的、牛皮纸褶皱真实。夸张只发生在节奏上，不发生在材质上。
■ 表演
不演情绪，演贯彻自己战术的过程；戏在眼睛里。安全线：视线始终在执行任务，绝不呆滞空洞凝视；自然眨眼。不瞪眼、不嘶吼、不挤眉弄眼。
■ 声音
只有画内声：从厨房透来的收录机老歌、环境声与动作声。无配乐、无旁白、无字幕。
■ 全片禁止

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

【SCENE / 场景】
深夜，香港旧公寓。她刚把闯入者摔向珠帘——本段从落点开始：他摔进走廊、看见满墙奖杯；她走出来问了一句，他却把手伸向身旁的墙角、从墙角后面摸出一束花；她眯眼审视，接过闻了闻，笑了一下，然后给了他答案。身体部分是电影武术编排的收尾——画面只呈现动作、位置与重心的变化，落地有冲击但无任何伤痕。

她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向墙角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。

【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在

第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

深夜，香港旧公寓。她刚把闯入者摔向珠帘——本段从落点开始：他摔进走廊、看见满墙奖杯；她走出来问了一句，他却把手伸向身旁的墙角、从墙角后面摸出一束花；她眯眼审视，接过闻了闻，笑了一下，然后给了他答案。身体部分是电影武术编排的收尾——画面只呈现动作、位置与重心的变化，落地有冲击但无任何伤痕。
【BLOCKING / 走位】
第一拍在厨房：他被牵着手臂绕髋翻转、朝珠帘门洞飞出。之后全部在走廊：他背朝下落在走廊地板中央、头朝奖杯墙一侧，全段躺着不起身，最多撑起一只手肘。关键：他倒下的位置紧挨珠帘门洞的墙棱——墙角在他一条手臂能够到的地方，花束平放在墙棱正后方的地砖上、机位看不见的死角：不在洞里、不在缝里、不在他身上。她随后拨帘走出，站定在他身侧上方，之后不再移动脚步。奖杯搁板在他视线斜上方。

【CAMERA / 摄影】
十个镜头、九个真实机位，全部手持、全部歪着、全部变形宽银幕定焦：①厨房全景（翻转瞬间画框颠动）；②走廊低角度（落地重颠再稳）；③贴地人像特写（呼吸级漂移）；④奖杯插入；⑤离地40厘米仰拍她（他失焦的肩在画框下缘）；⑥她肩上方俯角；⑦她的人像特写；⑧回到⑥同一机位；⑨花束大特写（她的脸俯入画框）；⑩他的仰视视点、她直视镜头（花束击中镜头时画框重颠一下）——全片她唯一一次看进镜头。绝不推近拉远。
【ACTING TASK】
他——终身动机：从小相信只要够浪漫就会被原谅。本场目标：把这次闯入变回"惊喜"。障碍：挨摔的懵、喘不上气、头顶奖牌墙、她的一言不发。战术：先缓过来，用眼睛在墙上找答案；伸手去墙角摸提前藏好的王牌——摸时脸上还是慌的、没有笑；花到手的瞬间才把笑硬挤出来——他真的相信这能行。
她——终身动机：这双手拿过冠军，但家才是她唯一卸下防备的地方。本场目标：给这段关系下结论。障碍：花是香的，笑是熟悉的。战术：问话是审问不是尖叫；看他伸向墙角时眯眼估价；接花前先怀疑；闻花是最后一次核对，冷笑是核对的结果；把答案连着花一起还给他。她不生气；她只是结束它。
（安全线：两人的视线始终在执行任务；自然眨眼。）
【DIALOGUE】
三句台词，全部粤语，无字幕。
她（0:10.5，平静低沉、带无奈的责备）：「你喺度做咩呀，Li？」
他（0:12.5，结巴、沙哑、马上开口）：「我⋯我想俾個surprise你⋯」
她（0:25.5，平静、缓慢、一字一顿，不提高音量）：「你成身都係red flag味呀，Li。」
【LIGHT / 光】——走廊的光：不亮、压得很低、几乎不存在
走廊没有任何灯、自己不发光——画面接近黑，只靠邻室漏来的微弱反射光。一端是厨房珠帘门洞的红反光——微弱、随珠帘摆动在地砖上晃；另一端是门厅红罩台灯的暖红——淡淡余晖铺在走廊尽头地砖和墙面下部。人物大部分沉在暗处：他一半轮廓被珠帘红反光勾出、另一半沉进黑，伸向墙角的手臂整个在阴影里，湿的脸和湿的西装肩在红反光里反着细碎湿高光；她只是轮廓——背后珠帘红勾边，正面门厅暖红极弱托起（明暗远大于3:1）。奖杯只是暗处金属微光带halation。黑里保有细节、绝不死黑，但绝不提亮：全段没有明亮画面，曝光宁欠勿过，绝无平光。
【SOUND】
从门洞透来的收录机粤语老歌（闷、远）——底下：撞破珠帘的哗啦、湿西装背砸瓷砖的闷湿声、被挤出的喘息、珠串衰减碰撞、她的小跟鞋两步、三句粤语台词、他在墙角后面一阵摸索的窸窣（擦墙皮、拍地砖、拧腕）、画外先响半拍的牛皮纸、花束被拖出墙角的哗啦、闻花一次缓慢吸气与一声几乎无声的鼻息冷笑、花束掷向镜头的扑打与一声受击般的闷响。无配乐。
【FORBIDDEN / 禁止】（本段追加）
第三个人；他起身站立或爬行；花束从西装、口袋、墙洞、地缝或身下出现——唯一来源是墙角正后方的地面；花束外观偏离参考（换色、加花、换包装）；花束在被拖出之前入画；任何伤痕或红色液体；他脸上身上的液体只是清水——绝无奶白色液滴；她出汗或脸上有水光；走廊出现自己的顶灯或壁灯；奖杯搁板出现在厨房那一拍；铜牌以外的任何文字；除这一束外的其他花；他手上出现戒指；她流泪或提高音量；字幕。

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine

reference_elements.description:
The entry of her small Hong Kong studio flat, mid-1990s, at night: a cramped pocket by the
front door, drowned in warm darkness. On the left, a square dark-wood shoe cabinet; on its
top a small table lamp with a crimson fabric shade on a slim dark stem — the only light,
a saturated red-amber core with soft halation whose pool covers just the cabinet top: a
famille-rose porcelain teacup on its saucer with cold green tea and a lipstick print, and a
floral-enamel thermos behind it. Above the cabine
